한 장치만 허브에서도 직결에서도 실패하면 그 장치를 점검하세요. 허브 정: If only one device fails in either the hub or direct connection, check that device. Do not connect an adapter that does not match the hub's ratings.
외장 키보드·화상 키보드와 BIOS·로그인 화면에서 입력되는지 비교하세요: Compare input from the external keyboard/on-screen keyboard and the BIOS/login screen.
BIOS에서는 되면 Windows의 필터 키·입력 드라이버·앱을 확인하세: If it works in BIOS, check the Windows filter keys, input drivers, and apps.
다른 PC에서도 안 되면 케이블·배터리·키보드를 점검하세요. 로그인할 수: If it doesn't work on another PC, check the cables, battery, and keyboard. Do not remove your input device before you have a way to log in.
첫 단계에서 변화가 없다면 ‘키보드를 다시 연결하고 다른 포트에서 테스트: If there is no change in the first step, compare the steps in order, including ‘Reconnect the keyboard and test on a different port’. If symptoms disappear immediately after certain actions or the conditions for their occurrence change, this can be an important clue in narrowing down the cause.
메모장과 다른 앱에서 같은 키가 실패하는지, 다른 키보드는 정상인지 비교: Compare whether the same keys fail in Notepad and other apps, and whether they work normally on other keyboards.
If only a specific app fails, check the shortcuts, key mapping, and input language.
같은 물리 키가 모든 앱에서 실패하면 오염·스위치를 점검하세요. 액체 유: If the same physical key fails in all apps, check for contamination/switches. If liquid enters the product, turn off the power and discontinue use.
Distinguish between repetition when pressing once briefly or repetition when pressing long.
짧은 입력도 중복되고 다른 PC도 같으면 스위치 채터링·펌웨어를 점검하세: If short inputs are duplicated and the same occurs on other PCs, check the switch chattering/firmware.
길게 누를 때만 불편하면 반복 지연을 조절하세요. 필터 설정으로 고장 증: If it is inconvenient to only press and hold, adjust the repeat delay. Don’t assume that the problem has been repaired after hiding the symptoms of the problem through filter settings.
커서만 안 움직이는지 클릭도 안 되는지, 유선·동글·Bluetooth 연: Whether only the cursor is not moving or clicking, distinguish between wired, dongle, and Bluetooth connections.
If it clicks, check the sensor/surface, if there is no input at all, check the battery/connection.
다른 PC에서도 실패하면 마우스를 점검하세요. Windows 전체가 멈춘: If it also fails on another PC, check your mouse. Distinguish between a complete Windows freeze and an input device failure.
첫 단계에서 변화가 없다면 ‘다른 포트·표면·배터리로 기본 점검하기’까지: If there is no change in the first step, compare in order, including ‘Basic inspection with different ports, surfaces, and batteries.’ If symptoms disappear immediately after certain actions or the conditions for their occurrence change, this can be an important clue in narrowing down the cause.
유선 마우스에서도 지연되는지와 높은 CPU·디스크 부하를 함께 확인하세요: Also check if there is a delay with the wired mouse and if there is a high CPU/disk load.
If it's only bad for wireless, compare receiver distance, interference, and battery.
유선도 같으면 시스템 부하·디스플레이 반응을 점검하세요. 폴링 레이트 변: If the wires are the same, check the system load and display response. Compare the same operation before and after changing the polling rate.
한 번의 짧은 클릭이 두 번 기록되는지 다른 PC와 기본 버튼 설정으로: Compare your default button settings with other PCs to see if one short click is recorded twice.
다른 PC에서도 같으면 스위치 마모 가능성이 있으므로 수리·교체를 검토하: If the same problem occurs on other PCs, the switch may be worn, so consider repairing or replacing it.
한 앱에서만 같으면 앱 설정을 확인하세요. 더블클릭 속도를 바꾸는 것이: If it's the same in one app, check the app settings. Changing the double-click speed will not fix a broken switch.
터치패드 토글 키·Windows 설정과 외장 마우스 연결 시 자동 비활성: Check the touchpad toggle key/Windows settings and the automatic disabling option when connecting an external mouse.
If you turn it back on in Settings, see if it persists even after rebooting and disconnecting the external mouse.
장치가 없으면 제조사 터치패드·직렬 I/O 드라이버를 점검하세요. 대체: If the device is not present, check the manufacturer's touchpad/serial I/O driver. Do not uninstall existing drivers without a replacement input device.
첫 단계에서 변화가 없다면 ‘터치패드 단축키와 설정 확인하기’까지 순서대: If there is no change in the first step, compare in order through ‘Checking touchpad shortcuts and settings’. If symptoms disappear immediately after certain actions or the conditions for their occurrence change, this can be an important clue in narrowing down the cause.
Determine if it pops even when you lift your hand, or if it only pops when your palm touches it while typing.
입력 중에만 생기면 민감도·팜 리젝션을 조절하고 표면을 마른 상태로 유지: If it only occurs while typing, adjust sensitivity/palm rejection and keep the surface dry.
손을 떼도 움직이거나 터치패드가 들뜨면 사용을 멈추고 배터리 팽창·하드웨: If the device moves or the touchpad lifts when you release it, stop using it and have the battery checked for swelling or hardware.
게임 실행 전 Windows 게임 컨트롤러 테스트에 장치와 버튼 반응이: Before running the game, make sure your device and buttons respond by testing your Windows game controller.
USB·Bluetooth 연결만 보이고 입력 장치가 없으면 모델의 공식: If you only see USB/Bluetooth connection and no input device, check the official driver/input mode for your model.
Windows 테스트는 정상이면 게임별 입력 설정으로 진행하세요. 가상: If the Windows test is normal, proceed with the input settings for each game. Do not add multiple virtual controllers at the same time.
다른 정상 카드리더기로 모델·용량이 표시되는지 확인하고 기존 데이터 유무: Check whether the model and capacity are displayed with another normal card reader and determine whether existing data exists.
If it is visible on another reader, check the existing reader/adapter contacts.
RAW·0GB·미할당이면 쓰기를 중단하고 복구를 검토하세요. 원본 카드에: If it is RAW, 0GB, or unallocated, stop writing and consider recovery. Do not overwrite formatting or recovery results on the original card.
첫 단계에서 변화가 없다면 ‘SD 카드 잠금 스위치와 접촉 상태 확인하기: If there is no change in the first step, compare in order through ‘Check SD card lock switch and contact status’. If symptoms disappear immediately after certain actions or the conditions for their occurrence change, this can be an important clue in narrowing down the cause.
Make sure the locking tab on the card adapter and other readers are also read-only.
If the problem is with the tab/reader, change to a normal adapter and copy important files first.
잠금이 없어도 계속 쓰기 금지면 카드 고장 보호 상태일 수 있습니다. 강: If it continues to be write-protected even without a lock, the card may be in failure protection. Prioritize securing and replacing data over forced formatting.
카메라 앱 권한보다 먼저 장치 관리자에 USB 카메라가 나타나는지 확인하: Make sure your USB camera appears in Device Manager before the camera app permissions.
In direct connection, if it is recognized, check the hub, extension cable, and USB power.
다른 PC도 장치를 못 찾으면 케이블·웹캠 점검이 필요합니다. 인식되지: If other PCs cannot find the device, you need to check the cables and webcam. Unrecognized devices cannot be recovered by setting permissions alone.
첫 단계에서 변화가 없다면 ‘카메라 물리 셔터·기능 키 확인하기’까지 순: If there is no change in the first step, compare in order through ‘Checking camera physical shutter and function keys.’ If symptoms disappear immediately after certain actions or the conditions for their occurrence change, this can be an important clue in narrowing down the cause.
Windows 사운드 출력 테스트와 앱 볼륨을 확인하고 HDMI·스피커·: Check the Windows sound output test and app volume, and see the actual output destination among HDMI, speakers, and headphones.
If you hear a test sound, check the output/mute for each app.
If the test does not work, check the speaker power source, cable, output device, and driver. Also note that the monitor does not have speakers.
사운드 설정뿐 아니라 장치 관리자의 오디오·디스플레이 오디오 항목을 확인: Check the audio/display audio items in device manager as well as the sound settings.
If there is an error device, check the audio/chipset driver for your PC model.
HDMI 오디오만 없으면 GPU 드라이버·출력 연결을 점검하세요. 모든: If you don't have HDMI audio, check your GPU driver/output connections. Do not remove all audio devices at once.
같은 음원을 다른 출력 장치와 다른 앱에서 재생하고 유선·무선 차이를 비: Play the same sound source on different output devices and different apps and compare the differences between wired and wireless.
If it breaks only on one output, check the terminal, cable, and corresponding device enhancements.
모든 출력이 시스템 부하 때 함께 깨지면 드라이버 지연을 조사하세요. 샘: If all outputs crash together under system load, investigate driver latency. Compare sampling formats one at a time within the supported range.
Check the individual volume of the system, app, and external speakers and the automatic attenuation during communication.
If only a specific app is small, adjust the app volume mixer and app output.
모든 앱이 작으면 출력 장치·단자·장치 정격을 확인하세요. 증폭을 크게: If all apps are small, check the output device/terminal/device rating. Be careful of damage to your hearing and speakers before increasing the amplification significantly.
업데이트 뒤 출력이 모니터 HDMI 등으로 바뀌었는지와 오디오 드라이버: After the update, check whether the output has changed to monitor HDMI, etc. and the audio driver version.
If only the output selection has changed, restore to the original device and check the test sound.
출력 자체가 없으면 제조사 드라이버 롤백·재설치를 검토하세요. 업데이트: If there is no output, consider rolling back or reinstalling the manufacturer's driver. Rather than removing all updates, narrow down what has changed.
같은 헤드폰을 다른 기기에서 시험하고 PC 단자가 출력 전용인지 4극 콤: Test the same headphones on another device and check whether the PC terminal is output only or a 4-pole combo.
If the headphones are OK, check the jack detection/device type of the manufacturer's audio console.
단자 움직임에 따라 끊기면 접촉 점검이 필요합니다. 전면 단자와 후면 단: If the terminal breaks due to movement, a contact check is required. Compare the front and rear terminals under the same conditions.
Windows 입력 테스트의 레벨 막대가 움직이는지와 선택된 마이크·물리: Check that the level bar in Windows Input Test is moving and that mic/physical mute is selected.
Windows에서는 반응하면 앱의 마이크 선택·개인정보 권한을 확인하세요: On Windows, if it responds, check the app's microphone selection and privacy permissions.
레벨도 안 움직이면 연결·입력 음소거·드라이버를 점검하세요. 앱 권한 허: If the level does not move, check the connection/input mute/driver. Allowing app permissions alone cannot solve physical connection issues.
첫 단계에서 변화가 없다면 ‘마이크 음소거와 입력 장치 선택 확인하기’까: If there is no change in the first step, compare in order through ‘Mute the microphone and check the input device selection.’ If symptoms disappear immediately after certain actions or the conditions for their occurrence change, this can be an important clue in narrowing down the cause.
실제 선택 마이크와 입과의 거리, Windows 입력 테스트 레벨을 확인: Check the distance between the actual selected microphone and your mouth, and the Windows input test level.
Windows부터 작으면 장치 입력 레벨·지원되는 증폭·연결 규격을 점검: Starting with Windows, check the device input level, supported amplification, and connection specifications.
Windows는 정상이고 앱만 작으면 앱 자동 감도·잡음 억제를 비교하세: If Windows is normal and the app is small, compare the app's automatic sensitivity and noise suppression. Excessive amplification can create noise and clipping.
헤드폰으로 바꿨을 때 에코가 사라지는지와 이 장치로 듣기·스테레오 믹스: Check if the echo disappears when you switch to headphones and select Listen to This Device and Stereo Mix.
Shorten the path for speaker sound to re-enter the microphone once it is removed from the headphones.
계속 남으면 앱별 모니터링·가상 오디오 라우팅을 확인하세요. 여러 모니터: If it persists, check monitoring/virtual audio routing for each app. Do not turn on multiple monitoring paths at the same time.
Windows 테스트 소리와 다른 앱은 정상인지 확인하고 문제 앱의 볼륨: Verify that Windows test sound and other apps are OK, and look at the volume mixer for the problem app.
If the app is muted or has a different output, correct only those items and then restart the app.
믹서도 정상이면 앱 자체 출력·파일 문제를 확인하세요. 시스템 오디오 드: If the mixer is also normal, check for output/file problems within the app itself. Don't start by uninstalling the entire system audio driver.
Windows 카메라 앱에서도 실패하는지와 셔터·키보드 카메라 토글을 확: Check if the Windows camera app also fails and toggle the shutter/keyboard camera.
카메라 앱은 정상이면 문제 앱의 권한·장치 선택·브라우저 권한을 확인하세: If the camera app is normal, check the permissions, device selection, and browser permissions of the problematic app.
모든 앱이 실패하면 장치 인식·제조사 드라이버를 점검하세요. 카메라가 필: If all apps fail, check device recognition/manufacturer drivers. Grant permission only to apps that require the camera.
Windows 카메라 접근·앱 접근·데스크톱 앱 접근과 브라우저 사이트: Check Windows camera access, app access, desktop app access, and browser site permissions respectively.
If only one site is blocked, only modify that site's permissions and options.
조직에서 관리됨으로 나오면 관리자에게 요청하세요. 정책·보안 제품을 우회: If it says managed by your organization, ask your administrator. Do not change the registry to bypass policies or security products.
물리 셔터를 열고 밝은 환경에서 Windows 카메라 앱 영상을 확인하세: Open the physical shutter and check the Windows Camera app video in a bright environment.
카메라 앱은 정상이면 화상 앱의 선택 장치·가상 카메라·배경 효과를 점검: If the camera app is normal, check the selected device, virtual camera, and background effects in the video app.
모든 앱에서 검으면 장치·드라이버·노출을 확인하세요. 렌즈를 가린 상태와: If all apps are black, check your device/driver/exposure. First distinguish between lens obstruction and hardware failure.
다른 회의 앱·브라우저 탭·가상 카메라 프로그램을 종료한 뒤 카메라 앱만: Close other meeting apps, browser tabs, and virtual camera programs and then run only the camera app.
When it runs independently, open the apps one by one to check the occupied paths.
If standalone execution fails after rebooting, check permissions, drivers, and security policies. Do not stop camera services or security all at once.
USB와 네트워크 연결을 구분하고 프린터 자체 네트워크 보고서·IP 주소: Distinguish between USB and network connections and check the printer's own network report/IP address.
IP로 접근되는데 검색만 안 되면 제조사 방식의 수동 추가·검색 서비스를: If you are accessed by IP but cannot search, check the manufacturer's manual addition and search service.
IP 접근도 실패하면 같은 망·전원·연결부터 점검하세요. 프린터 발견 실: If IP access fails, check the same network, power, and connection first. Do not install the driver repeatedly just because the printer fails to be discovered.
첫 단계에서 변화가 없다면 ‘프린터 전원을 껐다 켜고 상태 확인하기’까지: If there is no change in the first step, compare the steps in order, including ‘Turn the printer power off and on and check the status.’ If symptoms disappear immediately after certain actions or the conditions for their occurrence change, this can be an important clue in narrowing down the cause.
프린터 자체 출력·네트워크 보고서가 정상인지와 Windows 포트의 IP: Check whether the printer's own print/network report is normal and the IP of the Windows port matches.
If the printer is normal and only the IP has changed, change it to the correct port/address.
자체 출력도 실패하면 장치 오류부터 해결하세요. 다른 프린터를 기본값으로: If self-printing also fails, resolve the device error first. Don't hide the problem by making another printer the default.
Check the owner/document name of the stopped job and any printer panel errors.
Just cancel the problem job and print a small test document when the queue is empty.
취소도 안 되면 관리자·제조사의 스풀러 복구 절차를 따르세요. 대기열 초: If cancellation does not work, follow the administrator/manufacturer's spooler recovery procedures. Clearing a queue can also clear other users' jobs.
Check the event log to see the status of the service and whether it stops again immediately after starting.
특정 프린터 드라이버 설치 후 반복되면 해당 드라이버의 지원 버전·제거: If the problem repeats after installing a specific printer driver, check the supported version and uninstallation procedures for that driver.
서비스를 시작해도 바로 실패하면 로그로 원인을 좁히세요. 시스템 폴더 권: If the service fails immediately after starting, narrow down the cause by looking at the logs. Do not change system folder permissions or delete spool files first.
작은 텍스트 문서와 큰 PDF의 첫 장 대기·연속 인쇄 속도를 구분하세요: Distinguish between first page standby and continuous print speeds for small text documents and large PDFs.
If only large files are slow, compare the resolution, duplex, and app output method one by one.
모든 문서가 느리면 네트워크·드라이버·프린터 사양을 확인하세요. 장치의: If all documents are slow, check the network, driver, and printer specifications. Also consider the physical print speed limitations of your device.
PC 문서가 아닌 프린터 자체 테스트 페이지에서도 줄·색 이상이 나는지: Check for line and color abnormalities on the printer's self-test page, not on the PC document.
If the self-printing is bad, check the ink, toner, nozzle, and alignment according to the manufacturer's procedures.
자체 출력은 정상이면 앱·용지 종류·품질 설정을 확인하세요. 헤드 청소를: If self-printing is normal, check the app, paper type, and quality settings. Repeated head cleaning may result in excessive ink consumption.
프린터 정확한 모델·Windows 버전과 드라이버 오류 문구를 확인하세요: Check the exact printer model/Windows version and driver error message.
If other apps also fail, check the manufacturer-supported drivers and existing cue settings.
한 앱만 실패하면 앱별 인쇄 문제로 분리하세요. 출처 불명 드라이버 도구: If only one app is failing, isolate the printing issue to each app. Do not install using driver tools from unknown sources or unsigned.
프린터와 PC의 네트워크 이름·IP 대역, 게스트망·단말 격리 여부를 확: Check the network name, IP band, guest network, and terminal isolation of the printer and PC.
같은 망인데 IP 접근은 되면 자동 검색보다 제조사의 주소 기반 추가를: If it is the same network and IP access is possible, consider adding based on the manufacturer's address rather than automatic search.
다른 망이거나 격리됐으면 관리자에게 연결 정책을 확인하세요. 공유기 보안: If it is a different network or is isolated, check the connection policy with the administrator. Do not turn off the router security entirely.
복합기의 인쇄 기능과 스캔 기능을 구분하고 제조사 스캔 앱에서도 인식되는: Distinguish between the printing and scanning functions of the all-in-one and make sure they are recognized by the manufacturer's scanning app.
If you just want to print, check out the scan-only driver, WIA, and TWAIN support.
장치 자체가 없으면 USB·네트워크 연결부터 점검하세요. 프린터 드라이버: If you do not have the device itself, check the USB/network connection first. Just installing the printer driver does not prepare the scanning function.
메모장의 작은 문서는 출력되는지와 문제 문서의 PDF 저장이 되는지 비교: Compare whether small documents in Notepad can be printed and whether the problem document can be saved as a PDF.
한 파일만 실패하면 다른 이름으로 복사해 파일·폰트·개체 문제를 점검하세: If only one file fails, copy it under a different name and check for file, font, or object problems.
앱 전체만 실패하면 앱 업데이트·인쇄 설정을 확인하세요. 모든 앱이 실패: If only the entire app fails, check the app update/print settings. Expand your scope to system queues and drivers only when all apps fail.
충전 LED·Windows 전원 인식과 정품 호환 어댑터 정격·충전 지원: Check the charging LED, Windows power recognition, genuine compatible adapter rating, and charging support port.
If it is recognized as another normal compatible charger, check the existing adapter/cable.
어떤 충전기도 인식하지 못하면 포트·전원 회로를 점검받으세요. 배터리 팽: If any charger is not recognized, have the port and power circuit checked. If the battery swells or overheats, stop charging.
제조사 앱에 배터리 보호·충전 한도가 설정됐는지와 현재 잔량·온도를 확인: Check whether battery protection and charging limits have been set in the manufacturer's app and the current remaining capacity and temperature.
한도 근처에서 멈추면 정상 제한일 수 있습니다. 제조사 설명의 재충전 시: If it stops near the limit, it may be a normal limit. Check the manufacturer's instructions for the conditions for starting recharge.
잔량이 낮은데도 충전 안 되면 어댑터 출력·배터리 상태를 점검하세요. 드: If charging does not occur even though the remaining charge is low, check the adapter output and battery condition. Do not start by deleting the driver.
정격 어댑터를 직접 연결하고 유휴 상태와 게임 부하에서 잔량 변화를 비교: Connect the rated adapter directly and compare the changes in remaining power under idle and gaming load.
유휴에서는 충전되면 독·USB-C 전력 협상·고부하 시 제조사 보조 배터: When charging at idle, check the operation of the manufacturer's auxiliary battery during dock/USB-C power negotiation and high load.
유휴에서도 줄면 충전기·배터리를 점검받으세요. 출력이 부족한 충전기를 계: If it decreases even when idle, have the charger and battery inspected. Do not continue to use chargers with insufficient output or connect arbitrary high-voltage adapters.
같은 밝기·작업에서 배터리 보고서의 설계·완충 용량과 앱별 소모를 비교하: Compare the design/buffering capacity and consumption by app in the battery report at the same brightness/task.
완충 용량이 크게 줄었으면 배터리 열화를, 특정 앱이 크면 백그라운드·G: If the charging capacity has decreased significantly, check for battery deterioration, and if a specific app is large, check for background/GPU usage.
용량이 정상인데 급격히 꺼지면 잔량 측정·배터리 점검이 필요합니다. 배터: If the capacity is normal but suddenly turns off, it is necessary to measure the remaining capacity and check the battery. Do not completely discharge the battery repeatedly.
Compare the manufacturer's charging limits and the remaining power and actual usage time before and after reboot.
설정한 충전 한도에서만 멈추면 정상 동작일 수 있습니다. 한도를 확인하세: If it stops only at the set charging limit, it may be operating normally. Check your limits.
낮은 잔량에서도 값이 안 바뀌거나 갑자기 꺼지면 EC·배터리를 점검하세요: If the value does not change even when the remaining power is low or it suddenly turns off, check the EC/battery. Do not repeat forced full discharge even for calibration purposes.
BIOS·제조사 진단에서도 배터리가 없는지와 외부 전원만으로 켜지는지 확: Check BIOS/manufacturer diagnostics to make sure there is no battery and that the device turns on only from external power.
BIOS는 인식하고 Windows만 없으면 제조사 칩셋·전원 드라이버와: If the BIOS is recognized but Windows is not available, check the manufacturer's chipset/power driver and support recovery procedures.
BIOS도 못 찾으면 배터리·연결 점검을 받으세요. 내장 배터리를 전원이: If you can't find the BIOS, have the battery/connection checked. Do not disconnect the built-in battery while it is connected to power.
터치패드·하판 들뜸이나 틈이 생기면 누르거나 분해해 확인하지 말고 사용을: If the touchpad or bottom cover lifts or gaps appear, stop using the laptop. Do not press or disassemble it to investigate.
안전하게 할 수 있으면 전원을 끄고 충전기를 분리한 뒤 가연물에서 떨어뜨: If safe, shut it down, disconnect the charger and keep it away from flammable materials. Contact the manufacturer for repair.
연기·열·화재가 있으면 접근·운반을 중단하고 긴급 대응을 요청하세요. 배: If there is smoke, excessive heat or fire, do not approach or move it; seek emergency assistance. Do not puncture, charge, crush or put the battery in household waste.
Even if the bottom plate or touchpad is lifted, first suspect that the battery may be swollen.
첫 단계에서 변화가 없다면 ‘즉시 사용과 충전을 중지하기’까지 순서대로: If there is no change in the first step, compare the steps in order from ‘Use immediately to Stop charging’. If symptoms disappear immediately after certain actions or the conditions for their occurrence change, this can be an important clue in narrowing down the cause.
Check the high sensor, load, and fan status among CPU, GPU, and storage devices.
유휴부터 높으면 막힌 흡배기·팬을, 특정 작업에서만 높으면 해당 부품의: If it is high from idle, check for a clogged intake/exhaust fan or a clogged intake/exhaust fan, and if it is high only during certain operations, check the cooling/power of the relevant parts.
보호 종료·냄새가 있으면 사용을 멈추세요. 모든 부품에 하나의 정상 온도: End of protection: Stop use if there is an odor. Don't apply one normal temperature standard to all components.
단단한 평면에서 통풍구를 막지 않은 상태와 침구 위 사용 상태의 차이를: See the difference between using it on a solid surface with the vents unblocked and on bedding.
If the environment improves, adjust the intake and exhaust and power profile.
팬 미동작·보호 종료가 남으면 제조사 점검을 받으세요. 뜨거운 노트북을: If the fan does not operate or protection ends, have it inspected by the manufacturer. Do not refrigerate or freeze a hot laptop or clean the interior while it is turned on.
부하 증가에 따른 바람 소리인지 긁힘·진동인지와 CPU·GPU 사용률을: Check whether there is wind noise, scratching, or vibration due to increased load, and the CPU/GPU usage rate.
고부하와 함께 커지면 부하 종료 후 줄어드는지 확인하고 냉각 경로를 점검: If it increases with high load, check to see if it decreases after the load ends and check the cooling path.
긁힘·진동이 남으면 전원 분리 후 케이블 접촉·베어링을 점검받으세요. 회: If scratches or vibration remain, disconnect the power source and inspect the cable contact and bearings. Do not stop the rotating fan with your hand.
Check actual CPU utilization/temperature in idle state and manufacturer cooling profile.
If background activity is high, see if the fan speed goes down after the task is completed.
낮은 부하에서도 과열·고회전이면 센서·쿨러를 점검하세요. 소음을 줄이려고: If overheating or high rotation occurs even at low load, check the sensor and cooler. Do not turn off the fan to reduce noise.
해당 팬이 제로 RPM 지원인지와 현재 온도·부하에서 회전해야 하는 조건: Check the manual to see if the fan supports zero RPM and if it must rotate at the current temperature and load.
정상 정지 조건이면 오류가 아닐 수 있습니다. 부하 시 안전 범위에서 회: If it is a normal stopping condition, it may not be an error. See if it starts spinning in the safe range under load.
회전해야 하는데 멈추면 부하를 중단하고 전원 분리 후 팬 연결·장치를 점: If it stops spinning when it should, stop the load, disconnect the power, and check the fan connection/device. Do not continue testing while increasing the temperature.
종료 전 CPU·GPU 온도와 팬 바람, 식은 뒤에만 켜지는지 기록하세요: Record the CPU/GPU temperature and fan speed before shutting down, and whether it turns on only after it cools down.
If it is connected to heat, stop heavy loads and inspect the vent, fan, and heat sink.
온도와 무관하게 꺼지면 어댑터·전원 문제도 조사하세요. 열 보호 기능을: If it turns off regardless of temperature, also investigate adapter/power issues. Do not bypass thermal protection or force a repeat boot.
같은 작업을 AC 전원과 배터리에서 비교하고 제조사 전원 프로필을 기록하: Compare the same task on AC power and battery and note the manufacturer power profile.
배터리에서만 클럭·GPU 전력이 낮으면 정상 전력 제한인지 제조사 사양을: If clock/GPU power is low only on battery, check the manufacturer's specifications to see if it is a normal power limit.
유난히 느리거나 갑자기 꺼지면 배터리 상태·펌웨어를 점검하세요. 보호 제: If it is unusually slow or suddenly turns off, check the battery status and firmware. Do not force AC performance by disabling protection restrictions.
전원 LED·팬은 복귀했는데 화면만 없는지, PC 전체가 복귀하지 않는지: Check whether the power LED and fan have returned, but only the screen is missing, or the entire PC has not recovered.
화면만 없으면 영상 출력·그래픽 드라이버를, PC 전체면 칩셋·전원 전환: If there is only a screen, check the video output/graphics driver, and check the chipset/power switch for the entire PC.
외장 장치 분리로 정상화되면 하나씩 재연결하세요. 강제 종료 전 저장하지: Once the external devices are normalized by disconnecting them, reconnect them one by one. Consider losing any unsaved work before force quitting.
현재 AC·배터리별 덮개 닫기 동작과 외장 모니터·도킹 상태를 확인하세요: Check the current cover closing operation for each AC/battery and the external monitor/docking status.
If it is Do nothing, change it to your desired power saving behavior and check for actual entry.
설정이 맞는데도 진입 안 되면 실행 앱·덮개 센서·제조사 유틸리티를 점검: If you cannot enter even though the settings are correct, check the running app, lid sensor, and manufacturer utility. Do not put devices that are not power saving in your bag.
관리자 터미널의 powercfg /lastwake와 powercfg /w: Check the woken devices and reservations with powercfg /lastwake and powercfg /waketimers in the administrator terminal.
Once a specific device/task is identified, only review the wake permissions for that item.
원인이 없으면 이벤트의 절전 복귀 시각을 조사하세요. 모든 예약·네트워크: If there is no cause, investigate the wake-up time of the event. Do not turn off all reservation and network power functions at once.
powercfg /a로 지원 전원 상태와 최대 절전 미지원 사유를 먼저: First check the supported power status and reason for not supporting hibernation with powercfg /a.
지원되지만 비활성화면 관리자 권한과 조직 정책을 확인한 뒤 공식 활성화: If it's supported but disabled, check your administrator permissions and organization policies and follow the official activation process.
하드웨어·정책상 미지원이면 지원되는 종료·절전 방식을 사용하세요. 메뉴만: If it is not supported due to hardware or policy, use a supported shutdown/sleep method. Just adding a menu does not mean that a feature is supported.
발생 조건과 먼저 할 일: Conditions for occurrence and what to do first
안전 모드도 실패하고 디스크 읽기 오류가 있으면 시스템 복구보다 중요한: If safe mode also fails and you have disk read errors, prioritize securing important files over system recovery.
If interruption, backup, or administrator confirmation is required, do not continue with the actions below.
같은 작업에서 오류가 사라졌다면 다음 변경을 하지 마세요. 계속되면 두: If the error disappears in the same operation, do not make any further changes. If it continues, check the second action.
첫 조치 후에도 같은 오류가 남을 때만 진행하세요. 작업 전 필요한 파일: Proceed only if the same error remains after the first action. Preserve necessary files and existing settings before starting work.
오류 창이 사라졌는지만 보지 말고 실패했던 기능을 같은 조건에서 확인하세: Don't just see that the error window has disappeared, check the function that failed under the same conditions. If it repeats, decide the next inspection based on the criteria below.
복구 후에도 같은 프로세스가 종료되면 덤프·스토리지 이벤트를 함께 분석하: If the same process terminates after recovery, analyze dump and storage events together. If there is a read error, stop repeating the recovery command.
오류 코드·발생 작업·실행한 조치·결과를 함께 기록하세요. 같은 조치를: Record the error code, action that occurred, action taken, and result. Rather than repeating the same actions, narrow your inspection based on newly identified clues.
If a test error occurs even with the basic memory settings, check the RAM and slots first. A normal test alone does not rule out a driver problem.
기본 클럭에서도 재발하면 모듈·슬롯별 검사와 덤프를 비교하세요. 페이지: If it recurs even at the default clock, compare the inspection and dump for each module and slot. Don't try to fix RAM corruption just by adjusting the page file.
한 장치·드라이버 변경 뒤 반복되면 해당 드라이버를 우선 조사하고, 무작: If the problem repeats after changing a device or driver, check the driver first, and if random, check the RAM status.
If you keep seeing the same file name, forward the version/dump/reproduction work to the manufacturer. Don't delete a file just because its Windows core file name appears.
같은 .sys 파일과 작업에서 반복되면 해당 제품의 드라이버·보안 소프트: If the same .sys file and task is repeated, first compare driver and security software changes for that product.
파일명이 달라지거나 앱 여러 개에서 재발하면 메모리·시스템 파일까지 점검: If the file name changes or the problem recurs in multiple apps, check memory and system files. Do not disable security protection in bulk.
RAM 장착이나 필터 드라이버 설치 직후면 그 변경을 먼저 비교하고, 저: Immediately after installing RAM or installing a filter driver, compare the changes first, and back up any storage device errors.
기본 메모리 검사도 실패하면 모듈·슬롯 점검이 필요합니다. 검사 정상인데: If the basic memory test also fails, a module/slot check is required. If the test is normal but repeats, investigate the error driver in the dump.
튜닝 상태라면 값을 기록하고 제조사 기본 설정으로 비교하세요. WHEA: If it's in tune, record the values and compare them to the manufacturer's default settings. You need to check the components of the WHEA event.
If the problem repeats even in the default settings, request a CPU, RAM, PCIe, and power check. Do not decide to replace a specific part based solely on the WHEA name.
디스크 복사·특정 주변기기 사용 중인지 구분하고, 그 장치의 드라이버·펌: Determine if you are using disk copy or a specific peripheral device, and check driver/firmware support for that device.
장치별 시험에서도 원인을 못 찾으면 덤프 분석으로 지연 드라이버를 좁히세: If you can't find the cause through device-specific testing, narrow down the driver for the delay by analyzing the dump. Do not force the controller driver to be replaced with another random model.
드라이버 변경 직후라면 안정 버전으로 비교하고, BIOS 영상도 깨지면: If you have just changed the driver, compare it to the stable version, and if the BIOS video is also broken, check the hardware first.
If the problem repeats even with the basic clock and stability drivers, check the GPU temperature and power. Don't just hide errors by increasing the TDR timeout.
디스크가 BIOS에 없다면 부팅 복구를 멈추고 연결을 점검하세요. 원래: If the disk is not in the BIOS, stop boot repair and check the connection. Restore only if you know the original storage mode.
원래 모드에서도 실패하면 암호화 복구 키·파일을 확보하고 스토리지 드라이: If the original mode fails, obtain the encryption recovery key/file and check the storage driver/disk. Do not initialize the disk.
새 장치·보안 프로그램 후 발생했는지 구분하고, 기본 메모리 설정에서도: Determine if it occurred after a new device or security program, and check if it is the same in the default memory settings.
드라이버 복원 후에도 반복되면 메모리 검사와 덤프를 함께 확인하세요. 보: If it repeats after restoring the driver, check the memory check and dump as well. Turning off security checking is not a general solution to this error.
If it fails only when returning from sleep, compare it to the condition in which you disconnected unnecessary external devices.
If it repeats only when a specific device is connected, check the manufacturer's power switching driver. Do not turn off power saving features on any device without cause.
스토리지 오류·읽기 지연이 함께 있으면 백업을 먼저 하세요. 이름의 St: If storage errors and read delays occur together, make a backup first. The Store in the name does not refer to a Microsoft Store app.
스토리지 이벤트가 계속 생기면 디스크·케이블·펌웨어를 점검받으세요. 앱: If storage events continue to occur, have the disk, cable, and firmware checked. Don't try to fix it by resetting the App Store.
SMART 경고·이상음·인식 해제가 있으면 쓰기와 수리 검사를 중단하고: If there is a SMART warning, abnormal sound, or recognition cancellation, stop writing and repair tests and secure data first.
동일 볼륨 오류가 재발하면 물리 상태와 RAM까지 조사하세요. 원본 디스: If the same volume error recurs, also investigate the physical status and RAM. Do not repeat CHKDSK repair on the original disk.
오류 파일명이 특정 장치 드라이버와 연결되면 해당 장치의 공식 이전·최신: If the error file name is associated with a specific device driver, compare the official previous and latest supported versions for that device.
장치 분리로 안정되면 그 장치의 버전·덤프를 지원팀에 전달하세요. 원인: Once the device is stable by disconnecting it, send the version/dump of the device to the support team. Don't replace drivers randomly when the cause is unknown.
한 폴더·앱만 거부되는지와 조직 관리 경로인지 구분하세요. 접근 권한은: Distinguish between whether only one folder/app is being rejected or whether it is an organization-managed path. Modify access rights only within the scope permitted to you.
사용자 폴더에서는 성공하면 대상 경로의 권한·보안 정책을 확인하세요. W: In the user folder, if successful, check the permissions and security policies of the destination path. Do not change Windows full ownership or Everyone permissions in bulk.
업데이트·앱 실행·백업 중 어느 작업에서 파일을 못 찾는지와 누락 경로를: Distinguish between update, app execution, and backup in which operation the file cannot be found and the missing path.
같은 경로가 계속 누락되면 해당 앱·업데이트의 원본 파일과 설치 로그를: If the same path continues to be missing, check the original file and installation log of the app/update. Do not download unrelated system files from the Internet.
입력값·대상 디스크·업데이트 작업 등 오류가 난 단계부터 구분하세요. 코: Distinguish from the stage where the error occurred, such as input value, target disk, and update operation. Don't apply the same registry prescription to a single piece of code.
정확한 단계와 로그가 같으면 그 기능의 공식 복구 절차를 확인하세요. 파: If the exact steps and logs are the same, check the official recovery procedure for that feature. If it happens during a partition operation, do not format it before securing the files.
다운로드·설치 원본만 손상됐는지와 시스템 구성요소 오류인지 실패 로그로: Please check the failure log to determine if only the download/installation source is damaged or if there is a system component error.
정상 공식 원본에서도 반복되면 구성요소 저장소·디스크·RAM을 점검하세요: If it repeats even with the normal official source, check the component storage, disk, and RAM. Do not replace failing files with arbitrary content.
설치 대상·시스템 드라이브·복구 파티션 중 어디의 공간 부족인지 로그에서: Check the log to see if space is insufficient in the installation target, system drive, or recovery partition.
공간을 확보해도 같으면 오류가 가리키는 볼륨을 다시 확인하세요. 복구·E: If the same is true even after freeing up space, recheck the volume pointed to by the error. Do not delete the recovery/EFI partition to save space.
파일 복사·Windows 설치·압축 해제 중 어느 단계인지 확인하고 중요: Check whether you are copying files, installing Windows, or unzipping, and preserve important originals.
정상 원본과 다른 매체에서도 반복되면 RAM·디스크를 점검하세요. 읽기: If it repeats on media different from the normal original, check the RAM and disk. Do not overwrite or repeat repairs on originals with reading errors.
Check whether the Windows build, language, and edition match the recovery source. Also distinguish between organization source policies.
일치하는 원본도 실패하면 DISM·CBS 로그를 확인하고 관리자에게 전달: If the matching source also fails, check the DISM·CBS log and forward it to the administrator. Do not specify any ISO as the recovery source.
인터넷 전체 실패와 기능 원본 서버만의 접근 실패를 구분하고 조직 프록시: Distinguish between Internet-wide failure and access failure of only the functional source server and check the organization proxy/policy.
허용된 연결에서도 다운로드가 안 되면 해당 OS용 공식 오프라인 원본을: If you are unable to download even on an allowed connection, please review the official offline source for your OS. Do not disable the organization's firewall or update policy without permission.
KB별 실패 단계·CBS 로그를 먼저 확인하세요. 동일 코드가 항상 시스: Check the failure stage/CBS log for each KB first. The same code does not always mean that the system partition is insufficient.
같은 KB가 다시 롤백되면 서비스·구성요소·파티션 여유를 로그와 함께 점: If the same KB is rolled back again, check the service, component, and partition availability along with the logs. Do not arbitrarily extend the EFI/Recovery partition.
Windows Update를 직접 껐는지 최적화 도구·조직 정책이 껐는지: Distinguish whether Windows Update was turned off directly or through Optimization Tools or organization policy.
서비스가 다시 꺼지거나 정책으로 잠겼으면 설정을 덮어쓰는 원인을 확인하세: If the service is turned off again or locked by policy, determine what is causing the settings to be overwritten. Do not change all services to automatic start.
재부팅 대기 중인 설치를 마친 뒤 구성요소 저장소 손상과 단순 다운로드: After completing the installation pending reboot, distinguish between component repository corruption and simple download failure.
DISM도 실패하면 원본 접근과 CBS 로그를 확인하세요. 같은 캐시 삭: If DISM also fails, check the source access and CBS logs. Don't just repeat the same cache clearing or delete the corruption manifest yourself.
다른 설치·백업·검사가 파일을 쓰는 동안이면 종료를 기다리세요. 시스템: If another installation, backup, or test is writing files, wait for it to finish. Do not force-quit system processes.
재부팅 뒤에도 특정 파일이 잠기면 로그로 점유 제품을 확인하세요. 필요한: If a specific file is locked even after rebooting, check the log to see which product is occupied. If necessary, restore the original startup settings after a supported clean boot.
Compare whether other web connections are also slow, or whether it's just the update server that is timing out.
다른 연결에서는 성공하면 원래 회선·프록시 경로를 점검하세요. 서버 응답: If other connections are successful, check the original line/proxy path. When server response is delayed, do not repeat requests continuously.
같은 다운로드가 유선·무선 양쪽에서 끊기는지와 VPN 재연결 시각을 비교: Compare whether the same download is disconnected on both wired and wireless and the VPN reconnection time.
한 연결에서만 끊기면 케이블·무선·라우터를, 모든 연결이면 서버·필터를: If only one connection is disconnected, check the cable/wireless/router. If all connections are disconnected, check the server/filter. Make sure the file is completely downloaded before installing.
개인 PC의 오입력 프록시와 조직의 WSUS·내부 DNS 사용을 구분하세: Distinguish between your personal PC's mistyped proxy and your organization's use of WSUS or internal DNS.
조직 서버 이름 확인이 계속 실패하면 관리자에게 DNS·WSUS·프록시: If your organization's server name resolution continues to fail, forward your DNS, WSUS, and proxy records to your administrator. Do not overwrite internal server settings with public addresses.
한 KB의 다운로드만 실패하는지와 필요한 저장 공간·연결 상태를 확인하세: Check whether only one KB download fails and the required storage space and connection status.
그 KB만 반복 실패하면 공식 카탈로그의 OS·아키텍처를 대조하세요. 모: If repeating that KB fails, check the OS/architecture in the official catalog. If all updates fail, investigate components/services.
실패 KB와 다운로드 중단 이력을 확인하세요. 다운로드 완료 표시만으로: Check the failed KB and download interruption history. Just indicating that the download is complete does not mean that the package data is sufficient.
재다운로드도 같은 지점에서 실패하면 공식 KB 패키지·업데이트 로그를 확: If re-downloading fails at the same point, check the official KB package/update log. Do not force install packages that are different from your current OS.
실패 KB·제품을 확인하세요. Windows 업데이트·.NET·앱 설치가: Check the failed KB·product. Windows Update, .NET, and app installations may report the same code.
같은 코드라도 KB별 공식 알려진 문제를 확인하세요. 복구 파티션 변경: Even if it is the same code, check the official known issues for each KB. Please do not apply specific solutions, such as changing the recovery partition, to all 0x80070643.
누락 경로가 앱 파일·임시 폴더·업데이트 원본 중 어디인지 확인하고 이전: Check whether the missing path is app file, temporary folder, or update source, and record previous path changes.
같은 경로를 계속 못 찾으면 원본·환경 변수·설치 로그를 확인하세요. 없: If you still can't find the same path, check the source, environment variables, and installation log. Do not replace missing system folders by creating a random structure.
확장 코드와 SAFE_OS·FIRST_BOOT 등 실패 단계를 확인하세요: Check the extension code and the failure level, such as SAFE_OS·FIRST_BOOT. These are usually additional clues needed to investigate the driver.
다음 시도도 롤백되면 SetupDiag·업그레이드 로그의 장치 이름을 조: If the next attempt is also rolled back, examine the device name in the SetupDiag/Upgrade log. Do not change the BIOS/storage mode without logging.
Compare recent driver changes to ensure the device doesn't start on only one PC.
정상 지원 드라이버와 다른 포트에서도 시작 못 하면 다른 PC·제조사 진: If the device cannot be started using a different port than the normal supported drivers, diagnose the device by diagnosing another PC or manufacturer to determine the device malfunction.
하드웨어 ID에 맞는 모델·Windows 드라이버를 확보하세요. 같은 브: Obtain the model/Windows driver that matches your hardware ID. Do not replace it with a similar model from the same brand.
정확한 드라이버도 매칭되지 않으면 OS 지원·하드웨어 ID를 제조사에 확: If the correct driver does not match, check with the manufacturer for OS support and hardware ID. Do not turn off signature protection.
Determine whether the recently replaced driver and other devices with the same function are normal.
지원 드라이버 복원 후에도 로드가 안 되면 필터 프로그램·설치 로그를 확: If the supported driver does not load even after restoration, check the filter program/installation log. Do not delete registry filters blindly.
GPU·USB 등 정확히 어떤 장치인지 구분하세요. 장치가 문제를 보고했: Please distinguish exactly what device it is, such as GPU or USB. This means that the device has reported a problem and is not always a physical failure.
다른 PC도 같으면 장치·케이블을, 한 PC만 같으면 드라이버·포트·전원: If it is the same on other PCs, check the device/cable. If it is the same on only one PC, check the driver, port, and power. Don't buy a new device just by the code.
숨겨진 이전 장치만 표시되는지, 지금 실제로 연결한 장치가 빠진 것인지: Determine if you're only seeing old hidden devices or if the device you're actually connected to is missing.
현재 연결 장치가 안 나타나면 케이블·포트·전원을 확인하세요. 쓰지 않는: If the currently connected device does not appear, check the cable, port, and power. Previous device records that are not being used may not be a fault in and of themselves.
드라이버 출처와 서명·OS 지원 여부를 확인하고 공식 서명 버전으로 비교: Check the driver source, signature, and OS support, and compare with the official signed version.
공식 최신 드라이버도 거부되면 제조사에 서명·버전 정보를 전달하세요. 테: If the latest official driver is also rejected, send the signature/version information to the manufacturer. Do not bypass test signing mode or disabling integrity checking.
최근 설치·제거한 장치 관련 프로그램과 복구 지점·기존 설정을 확인하세요: Check recently installed/uninstalled device-related programs, recovery points, and existing settings.
제조사 복구 절차도 실패하면 장치별 구성 로그를 분석하세요. 다른 장치의: If the manufacturer recovery procedure fails, analyze the device-specific configuration log. Do not copy registry keys from other devices or delete filters in bulk.
본인이 비활성화한 것인지 조직 정책·하드웨어 토글이 제한한 것인지 확인하: Check to see if you have disabled it or if it is restricted by organization policy or hardware toggle.
Even if you activate it, if it turns off again or a different code appears, investigate the new code/policy. Do not force management policies to be overwritten.
Check whether the driver file has been quarantined or deleted and the recent installation failure history.
정상 공식 재설치 후에도 로드되지 않으면 보안 기록·필터·설치 로그를 확: If it doesn't load even after a normal official reinstall, check your security history, filters, and installation logs. Do not download driver DLL/SYS files separately.
Determine if only certain game scenes are failing or if other 3D apps are also failing.
한 게임이면 패치·설정·모드를, 여러 앱이면 기본 클럭·드라이버·GPU를: If it is one game, check the patches, settings, and modes, and if it is multiple apps, check the basic clock, drivers, and GPU. Don't hide failure by increasing the TDR value.
추가 오류 사유가 HUNG·RESET 등 무엇인지와 디스플레이 이벤트를: Check the additional error reason, such as HUNG·RESET, and the display event. The name alone does not mean that the GPU is physically missing.
같은 제거 사유가 반복되면 해당 사유와 드라이버·전원·온도를 함께 조사하: If the same reason for removal is repeated, investigate the reason along with the driver, power source, and temperature. When replacing a card, make a decision after comparative diagnosis.
직전 해상도·렌더링 모드 변경을 기본값으로 돌렸을 때만 정상인지 비교하세: Compare whether the previous resolution/rendering mode change was normal only when set to default.
기본 설정에서도 여러 앱이 리셋되면 안정 드라이버·전원·GPU를 확인하세: If several apps are reset even in the default settings, check the stable drivers, power, and GPU. If only one app fails, send the reproduction footage to the developer.
새 드라이버 설치 전후와 여러 3D 앱의 동작을 같은 기본 설정에서 비교: Compare the behavior of multiple 3D apps before and after installing a new driver, with the same default settings.
이전 안정 버전도 실패하면 GPU·시스템 상태를 점검하세요. 게임 하나의: If the previous stable version also fails, check your GPU/system status. Don't blame the entire driver on a single game failure.
If it only occurs in a specific window mode/resolution/mode, remove that condition and compare.
공식 기본 설정도 실패하면 앱 버전·재현 순서를 개발사에 보고하세요. 잘: If the official default settings fail, report the app version and reproduction order to the developer. Invalid API calls may not be resolved simply by reinstalling DirectX.
Contrast dxdiag's feature level with the game's required GPU/rendering modes.
필요 기능이 하드웨어에 없으면 공식 지원 모드 또는 요구 사양을 검토하세: If the required feature is not present on your hardware, please review the official support mode or requirements. You cannot force unsupported features by replacing DLLs.
주소 오타·만료된 도메인과 한 PC의 DNS 문제를 다른 장치·네트워크로: Divide address typos, expired domains, and DNS problems on one PC to other devices/networks.
여러 네트워크에서 같은 주소만 실패하면 사이트 측 DNS를 확인해야 합니: If only the same address fails on multiple networks, you may need to check your site-side DNS. Avoid repeatedly resetting unrelated network settings.
Compare the recently changed DNS/VPN values with the original auto-assignment/organization settings.
원래 값으로 복원해도 여러 도메인이 실패하면 공유기·VPN 정책을 확인하: If several domains fail even when restored to their original values, check the router/VPN policy. Do not replace your company's DNS with a public server.
다른 기기도 인터넷이 안 되는지와 공공 Wi-Fi 인증 필요 여부를 구분: Distinguish between whether other devices also don't have internet access and whether public Wi-Fi authentication is required.
모든 기기가 실패하면 회선·공유기부터 확인하세요. 인터넷 경로가 끊겼다면: If all devices fail, check the line and router first. If your Internet path is lost, it cannot be restored simply by changing the DNS address.
Compare whether the same site disconnects in other browsers and networks.
특정 회선·VPN에서만 실패하면 허용된 경로와 필터를 확인하세요. 모든: If it fails only on a specific line/VPN, check the allowed routes and filters. For all lines, report the error time to the site administrator.
다른 사이트도 시간 초과인지와 다른 네트워크에서 같은 주소가 열리는지 확: Check to see if other sites are also timing out and if the same address is opening on a different network.
모든 연결에서 그 사이트만 실패하면 서버 응답·장애를 확인하세요. PC: If only that site fails on all connections, check the server response/failure. Do not reinstall the system assuming it is a PC performance issue.
Check whether the address and port are correct and whether it is your own development server or an external service.
본인 서버라면 서비스 실행·수신 포트를 확인하세요. 외부 서비스라면 운영: If it is your server, check the service execution/listening port. If it is an external service, contact the administrator and avoid disabling the local firewall entirely.
공개 주소인지 사내 VPN·내부 DNS가 필요한 주소인지 먼저 구분하세요: First, determine whether it is a public address or an address that requires an in-house VPN or internal DNS.
다른 네트워크에서도 공개 이름이 해석되지 않으면 도메인 운영자에게 확인하: If your public name doesn't resolve on other networks, check with your domain administrator. Direct IP connection can create certificate/virtual host problems.
Wi-Fi 로밍·유선 전환·VPN 재연결 직후 한 번인지 안정된 연결에서: Check whether it happens once immediately after Wi-Fi roaming, wired switching, or VPN reconnection, or if it repeats even on a stable connection.
If it repeats on one connection, check the adapter connection history and VPN reconnection. A one-time error immediately after the intended transition may not be a malfunction.
Check whether airplane mode, cable, or wireless connection itself is disconnected.
연결은 복구됐는데도 실패하면 어댑터 상태와 다른 기기의 인터넷을 비교하세: If the connection is restored but fails, compare the adapter status with the Internet on other devices. Clearing your browser cache is not a substitute for line repair.
Check whether the same login/address movement is repeated in the secret window.
시크릿만 정상이면 문제 사이트 쿠키만 검토하세요. 모든 브라우저가 같으면: If only the secret is OK, review only the problem site cookies. If all browsers are the same, site redirection settings will need to be modified by the administrator.
Compare addresses/HTTPS ports and secure connections on other networks.
다른 네트워크도 실패하면 서버 TLS 구성을 확인해야 합니다. 보안 경고: If other networks also fail, you may need to check your server TLS configuration. Do not connect by bypassing security warnings or turning on older TLS.
Distinguish whether the PC time is incorrect and the site certificate has actually expired.
PC 시간이 맞아도 계속 경고면 사이트의 인증서 갱신을 기다리거나 운영자: If the warning persists even if the PC time is correct, wait for the site's certificate to be renewed or notify the administrator. Do not log in with the date set in the past.
Distinguish between a public site and a service that uses an organization's internal certificate.
내부 사이트는 관리자가 검증한 인증서 배포만 따르세요. 공개 사이트 경고: Internal sites should only follow administrator-verified certificate distribution. Check with your administrator for public site warnings and do not install arbitrary root certificates.
이전에 제출한 요청을 다시 보내라는 화면인지 확인하세요. 주문·결제였다면: Verify that the screen asks you to resend a previously submitted request. If it was an order/payment, check the processing history on the site first.
일반 페이지도 반복되면 새 탭·시크릿 창으로 비교하고 확장 기능을 조사하: If regular pages are repeated, compare them with a new tab/incognito window and investigate extensions. Do not repeatedly resubmit forms whose processing results you do not know.
한 앱의 같은 동작인지 여러 앱이 무작위 종료되는지와 오류 모듈을 구분하: Distinguish between the error module and whether it's the same behavior in one app or multiple apps quitting randomly.
한 앱이면 파일·모드·플러그인을, 여러 앱이면 RAM·시스템을 조사하세요: If it's one app, check the files, modes, and plugins. If it's multiple apps, check the RAM and system. Don't bypass protection features like DEP by turning them off.
앱·런타임의 x86·x64 요구와 DLL을 수동 복사한 이력을 확인하세요: Check the x86·x64 requirements of the app/runtime and the manual copy history of the DLL.
공식 앱·런타임 복구 뒤에도 같으면 실패 모듈과 아키텍처를 제작사에 확인: If the problem remains the same even after official app/runtime recovery, check with the manufacturer about the failed module and architecture. Do not overwrite system DLLs with Internet files.
Compare whether only the app in question failed to initialize and the latest app/security product updates.
If the official recovery install also fails, check the difference between the modules in the event and a clean boot. After confirmation, restore normal startup settings.
Compare the component listed in the error with the .NET/runtime version required by your app.
필요 버전이 설치됐는데도 실패하면 앱 로그와 Windows 기능 상태를: If it fails even though the required version is installed, check the app logs and Windows feature status. Don't consider .NET Framework and newer .NET as the same product.
Bad Image 메시지의 DLL 경로가 앱 폴더인지 Windows 폴더: Distinguish whether the DLL path in the Bad Image message is the app folder or the Windows folder.
앱 폴더면 해당 앱 복구를, 시스템 경로면 공식 시스템·런타임 복구를 확: If it is an app folder, check the app recovery, and if it is a system path, check the official system/runtime recovery. Do not replace DLL files directly.
본인 계정만 실패하는지와 보안 제품이 앱·파일 접근을 막았는지 확인하세요: Check whether only your account is failing and whether a security product is blocking access to apps and files.
If it only works on other allowed accounts, check the target path, license, and policy permissions. Do not grant Everyone permission or Run as administrator at once.
64비트 Windows라도 앱이 요구하는 런타임은 x86일 수 있으므로: Even on 64-bit Windows, the runtime your app may require may be x86, so check your app architecture.
공식 Visual C++ 패키지 복구 후에도 같은 파일이 없으면 앱 의존: If the same files are not present after restoring the official Visual C++ package, check the app dependencies and installation logs. Avoid downloading single DLLs.
기존 v14 런타임 설치만 확인하지 말고 앱이 요구하는 최신 지원 구성요: Don't just check for an existing v14 runtime installation, check to see if you have the latest supported components that your app requires.
맞는 아키텍처의 공식 패키지를 복구해도 같으면 앱 설치를 복구하세요. 다: If restoring the official package for the correct architecture still doesn't work, repair the app installation. Do not copy DLLs from other apps.
앱의 Visual C++ v14 요구와 x86·x64 패키지를 구분하세요: Distinguish between your app's Visual C++ v14 needs and x86·x64 packages.
표준 라이브러리 오류가 계속되면 공식 런타임 복구 로그와 앱 설치 상태를: If standard library errors persist, check the official runtime recovery log and app installation status. Do not arbitrarily place DLLs in system folders.
이 파일은 Visual C++ 2013 계열이므로 최신 v14 패키지만: This file is from the Visual C++ 2013 series, so make sure that only the latest v14 package is installed.
필요한 공식 2013 패키지·앱 복구 후에도 실패하면 앱 지원 환경을 확: If the recovery of the required official 2013 package/app fails, check the app support environment. Do not replace with a different generation runtime.
Visual C++ 2010 의존성과 앱의 지원 OS·아키텍처를 먼저 확: First, check Visual C++ 2010 dependencies and the app's supported OS/architecture.
공식 의존성 확보가 어렵거나 미지원 OS라면 제작사의 지원 버전을 검토하: If it is difficult to secure official dependency or if the OS is not supported, please review the supported version from the manufacturer. Do not download older DLLs from unofficial sites.
최신 DirectX가 있다는 사실과 구형 게임의 선택적 DirectX 구: Distinguish between having the latest DirectX and installing optional DirectX components for older games.
게임이 제공하는 공식 의존성 설치도 실패하면 설치 로그·지원 OS를 확인: If the official dependency installation provided by the game fails, check the installation log and supported OS. Do not manually replace DirectX core files.
컨트롤러 자체 인식 문제와 게임의 구형 DirectX 입력 라이브러리 누: Distinguish between issues with the controller recognizing itself and missing older DirectX input libraries in the game.
공식 구성요소 설치 후 DLL 오류는 없어도 입력이 안 되면 컨트롤러 설: After installing the official component, if input is not possible even if there is no DLL error, check the controller settings separately. Don't try to fix missing DLLs just by reinstalling the driver.
일반 설치 실패 코드이므로 설치 로그에서 실제 실패 직전 작업·권한·기존: This is a general installation failure code, so check the installation log for tasks, permissions, and existing version conflicts just before the actual failure.
같은 단계에서 반복되면 로그·앱 버전을 제작사에 전달하세요. 모든 폴더: If the same step is repeated, send the log/app version to the production company. Avoid changing any folder permissions or deleting the installation registry.
다른 MSI 설치나 Windows Update가 실제 진행 중인지 확인하: Check if another MSI installation or Windows Update is actually in progress.
If the same thing happens even after rebooting after the installation is complete, check the installation status and events. Do not force quit msiexec in progress or manually delete the Installer state.
설치 패키지의 어떤 프로그램·사용자 지정 작업이 실패했는지 로그에서 이름: Check the log for the name of which program/custom task in the installation package failed.
정상 패키지와 전제 구성요소에서도 같으면 작업 이름·종료 코드·OS 버전: If the normal package and prerequisite components are the same, send the task name, exit code, and OS version to the manufacturer. Please do not assume that the entire Installer service is broken.
SideBySide 이벤트가 요구하는 어셈블리 버전·프로세서 아키텍처를: First check the assembly version and processor architecture required by the SideBySide event.
일치하는 공식 런타임과 앱 복구 뒤에도 같으면 매니페스트·이벤트를 제작사: If the matching official runtime and app are still the same after recovery, forward the manifest/event to the manufacturer. One newer runtime doesn't replace all older dependencies.
전원이 들어오면 기존 멀티탭·케이블을 따로 점검하세요. 여러 부품을 동시: When the power comes on, check the existing power strip and cable separately. Do not replace multiple parts at the same time. If there is still no response, disconnect the power source and have the power and motherboard inspected. Do not open the power internals or arbitrarily short-circuit the pins.
정상 호환 충전기로 켜지면 기존 충전기·케이블 문제를 구분하세요. 충전: If it turns on with a normal compatible charger, determine whether the problem is with the existing charger or cable. If the charging LED does not turn on, the port and power circuit need to be checked. Do not disassemble the built-in battery arbitrarily.
대기 전원이 있다면 전원 분리 후 설명서의 프런트 패널 연결 위치와 케이: If there is standby power, disconnect the power and check the manual for the front panel connection location and cable disconnection. If there is no standby power, check the power supply before the button. Do not touch the pins while the power is connected.
고부하·온도 상승 때만 꺼지면 작업을 중단하고 냉각과 전원 공급을 점검하: If it turns off only under high load or temperature rise, stop work and check cooling and power supply. If it turns off even during light work, check the outlet, cable, and power supply. Do not confirm a power failure based on Kernel-Power records alone.
부품 교체 직후라면 전원 분리 후 CPU 보조전원과 RAM 장착을 설명서: If you have just replaced a part, disconnect the power and compare the CPU auxiliary power and RAM installation with the manual. If it continues to turn off immediately without change, the protection circuit may be activated. Do not turn it on repeatedly and have the parts inspected.
첫 부팅의 정상 트레이닝 시간이면 기다리세요. 같은 진단 LED로 반복되: If it is the normal training time for the first boot, wait. If the same diagnostic LED repeats, disconnect the power and check with the default memory configuration. If there is a burning smell or abnormal sound, stop immediately. Obtain an encryption recovery key before BIOS recovery/reset.
중지 코드가 있으면 해당 코드·드라이버를 먼저 조사하고 최근 변경 한 가: If there is a stop code, research the corresponding code/driver first and revert to only one recent change to compare. If the power fails without a cord, check the temperature and power path. During repeated reboots, back up your work files first.
RAM 또는 VGA 진단에 해당하면 전원을 분리한 뒤 지목된 부품의 장착: If it is a RAM or VGA diagnosis, disconnect the power source and check the installation of the specified component and auxiliary power. If the pattern does not match the manual, record the sound and contact the manufacturer. Do not judge a part based on another manufacturer's beep chart.
DRAM·VGA가 남으면 전원 분리 후 해당 부품을 점검하세요. CPU: If DRAM/VGA remains, disconnect the power source and inspect the relevant parts. If it indicates CPU, check the supported BIOS and auxiliary power source. If you enter BIOS with only BOOT left, check the OS drive recognition/booting items. Do not determine a defective part based on the LED alone.
드라이브가 보이면 표시되는 오류를 기록한 뒤 Windows 복구 환경에서: If you see the drive, note any errors that appear and then review Startup Repair in the Windows Recovery Environment. If the drive is not visible, resolve the storage device recognition issue first rather than using the boot recovery command. Do not initialize or format.
USB를 뺀 뒤 진행되면 장치를 하나씩 연결해 POST를 지연시키는 장치: If it goes away after unplugging the USB, connect devices one by one to find the one that is delaying POST. If the BIOS also freezes, check for hardware initialization issues first rather than reinstalling the OS. If there is an abnormal sound from the storage device, stop repeated booting.
드라이브는 보이면 Windows Boot Manager와 원래 부팅 모드: If you can see the drive, check Windows Boot Manager and the original boot mode. Don't guess and change modes. If the drive itself is missing, check for connection/slot problems. Do not initialize a disk with important data as if it were a new disk.
OS 디스크가 보이면 잘못된 부팅 순서나 부팅 항목 손상을 구분하고 데이: If you see the OS disk, determine whether it is a wrong boot order or a corrupted boot entry, and then secure the data and recover it. If recognition has disappeared, checking the cables and drives is a priority. Do not reinstall just by seeing the No OS message.
복구 옵션이 열리면 최근 변경에 맞춰 업데이트 제거 또는 복원 지점을 하: When the recovery option opens, review the uninstall updates or restore points one by one based on recent changes. If there are also disk errors or read delays, free the files first. Don't repeat a failed startup repair.
진행 표시가 변하면 강제로 끄지 마세요. 완전히 정지하면 공식 복구 미디: If the progress indicator changes, do not force it to turn off. If it freezes completely, consider accessing the recovery environment with official recovery media. If recovery media also stops accessing the disk, diagnosing the storage device is a priority. If you have important data, please stop factory reset.
안전 모드는 열리면 최근 드라이버·업데이트부터 되돌리고 정상 부팅과 비교: When safe mode opens, revert the most recent drivers/updates and compare with normal boot. If Safe Mode also reboots, investigate the stop code and storage status. Do not reset before obtaining your login files.
외장 장치 제거 후 Windows Boot Manager로 부팅되면 잘못: If it boots into Windows Boot Manager after removing an external device, check to see if an invalid boot target is the cause. If the system disk is visible and the same, check the boot mode and boot area. Do not switch between Legacy and UEFI blindly.
제조사 로고 전 지연이면 USB·POST를, Windows 로고 이후 지: If there is a delay before the manufacturer logo, check USB/POST, and if there is a delay after the Windows logo, check the storage device/update. If it's only slow after logging in, isolate it to a startup issue. Don't replace the drive right away because the overall bootup is slow.
안전 부팅을 직접 켰다면 해제 후 재시작하세요. 정상 모드에서 문제가 재: If you turned on Safe Boot yourself, disable it and restart. If the problem recurs in normal mode, investigate driver issues. If it was in safe mode for recovery purposes, resolve the original cause of the failure first. Check with your administrator about the boot policy for your organization's managed PCs.
ID가 일치하는 키가 있으면 입력하고 최근 BIOS·TPM·보안 부팅 변: If the key ID matches, enter the recovery key, then review recent BIOS, TPM or Secure Boot changes. If the key is unavailable, contact your organization administrator or the person who holds it. Clearing the TPM or formatting the disk does not decrypt your files.
기존 모드를 정확히 안다면 원래 설정으로 복원하고 부팅을 비교하세요. 암: If you know exactly what mode you had, restore the original settings and compare boot. Also have your encryption recovery key ready. If you have not changed the mode or the disk has disappeared, check the connection/drive. Avoid arbitrary setting changes and resets.
PC는 반응하면 출력 포트·입력 소스와 다른 케이블을 비교하세요. 저장: If the PC responds, compare the output port/input source with a different cable. If it is not saving, consider restarting your graphics driver. If the sound and input all stop, it may not be a simple monitor problem. Examine stopping time and power/temperature records.
모니터 메뉴는 보이면 입력 소스와 정상 케이블로 비교하세요. POST L: If you see the monitor menu, compare the input source with a normal cable. If the POST LED remains, check that component. The motherboard video port does not work on CPUs without built-in graphics. Don't reinstall Windows without a screen.
다른 기기를 같은 모니터·케이블에 연결해 화면이 나오면 원래 PC의 출력: If you connect another device to the same monitor/cable and the screen appears, check the output/POST of the original PC. If there is no signal from other devices, disconnect the cable and monitor input and test. Don't assume the GPU is defective just because there is no signal.
모니터 메뉴가 보이면 입력 신호·밝기와 영상 케이블을 비교하세요. 자체: When you see the monitor menu, compare the input signal/brightness and video cable. If you cannot see the menu at all, you need to check the monitor power and panel. Do not disassemble the monitor’s internal power supply.
작업 관리자가 열리면 Windows 탐색기를 다시 시작하고 바탕화면이 돌: Once Task Manager opens, restart Windows Explorer and see if your desktop returns. Even if it is restored, if it repeats when you re-login, check the startup apps and profiles. If Task Manager does not open, separate it into Driver/System Freeze.
다른 기존 계정은 정상이면 해당 프로필·시작 앱을 점검하세요. 기존 사용: If other existing accounts are normal, check their profiles and startup apps. Preserve existing user folders. If it is the same for all accounts, check Explorer, Output Settings, and Graphics Driver. Don't delete your user profile first.
복구 환경에 들어가면 문제 직전 품질 업데이트 제거 또는 드라이버 롤백을: Once you're in the recovery environment, consider uninstalling quality updates or rolling back drivers just before the issue. Do not turn off the power repeatedly while the update is still in progress. When a disk error occurs, securing files is a priority before recovery.
안전 모드가 열리면 장치 관리자에서 드라이버 롤백을 검토하고 이전 안정: Once Safe Mode opens, review the driver rollback in Device Manager and compare it to the previous stable version. If there is no BIOS video, check the cable/output/installation rather than removing the software. Do not use removal tools from unknown sources first.
If it only occurs in a specific app, compare the apps’ hardware acceleration/overlays one by one. If it blinks on the entire screen and in BIOS, compare cables and monitors first. If it is the same only in Windows, check the driver and refresh rate.
움직일 때만 찢어지면 게임의 V-Sync 또는 지원되는 VRR을 한 항목: If it only tears when moving, try switching the game's V-Sync or supported VRR settings one by one and compare. If lines remain in the still screen/monitor menu, check for panel/cable problems rather than synchronization.
스크린샷에도 이상이 남으면 렌더링·드라이버·GPU를 점검하세요. 기본 클: If problems remain in the screenshot, check the rendering, driver, and GPU. Compare at base clock. If the screenshot is normal, compare the output cable and monitor. If it crashes or overheats in the BIOS as well, stop load testing.
특정 앱만 멈추고 나머지는 반응하면 앱 문제로 분리하고 작업을 저장한 뒤: If only a specific app freezes and the rest responds, isolate it to an app issue, save your work, and quit. If the entire PC freezes, check the memory, disk, and temperature records at the time of occurrence. After force quitting, check for file corruption.
기본 디스플레이 어댑터로 나오면 제조사 그래픽 드라이버를 설치하고 해상도: If it appears as the default display adapter, install the manufacturer's graphics driver and check the resolution again. If you have a normal GPU but the mode you want is not available, check the bandwidth and supported resolution of the cable/dock. Don't force user resolution.
낮은 해상도에서는 높은 주사율이 보이면 케이블·독·포트 대역폭 제한을 확: If you see a high refresh rate at low resolution, check the cable/dock/port bandwidth limitations. If it's not in any resolution, check your monitor settings and drivers. Do not force refresh rates outside of the supported range.
단독은 정상인데 동시 연결만 실패하면 독·GPU의 동시 출력 수와 해상도: If single connection is normal but simultaneous connection fails, check the number of simultaneous outputs and resolution limits for the dock and GPU. If trying alone fails, compare cables and input sources first. Maintain the same port conditions before and after replacing the cable.
모니터 재시작만으로 복구되면 DP·HDMI 핸드셰이크와 모니터 절전 설정: If it is recovered just by restarting the monitor, check the DP/HDMI handshake and monitor power saving settings. If the PC itself does not wake up, check the power/chipset drivers. Instead of repeatedly forcing shutdowns, isolate the cause of the sleep.
직결은 정상인데 독·변환기를 거치면 실패하면 해당 장치의 방향성과 지원: If direct connection is normal but fails when connected through a reader/converter, check the directionality and support mode of the device. If direct connection fails, compare with another normal HDMI cable or device. Even though it looks the same, the laptop HDMI is not an input port.
If it is restored after direct connection, isolate the problem with the dock/adapter or connection negotiation after power saving. If other devices also fail, check the cable/monitor port. Unscrew and remove the DP plug with the lock.
GPU는 보이지만 기본 어댑터라면 맞는 제조사 드라이버를 설치하세요. 장: If you can see the GPU but it is a basic adapter, install the driver from the correct manufacturer. If the device itself is not present, disconnect the power source and check PCIe, auxiliary power, and slot compatibility. Do not mix modular cables of different powers.
지원 불일치이면 올바른 패키지를 받고 설치가 진행 중인 Windows U: If there is a support mismatch, obtain the correct package and retry after Windows Update is finished installing. If supported packages also fail, preserve installation logs and follow official recovery procedures. Do not turn off driver signature protection.
특정 앱에서만 실패하면 기본 설정·공식 패치로 비교하고 드라이버 변경 후: If the failure occurs only in a specific app, compare it to the default settings/official patch, and if it started after changing the driver, consider a rollback. If it happens repeatedly even at the default clock speed in multiple apps, cooling, power, and GPU need to be checked. Don't hide errors by increasing the TDR timeout.
안전 모드가 안정적이면 지원되는 안정 드라이버로 비교하고 같은 작업의 재: If Safe Mode is stable, compare it to a supported stable driver and see if the same operation occurs again. If the BIOS video is also corrupted or continues to fail at the default clock, have your hardware checked. Don't decide to replace your GPU based solely on the stop code.
유휴 상태부터 높으면 팬 동작과 흡배기를 점검하고 먼지는 전원 분리 후: From idle to high, check fan operation and intake/exhaust, and clean dust after disconnecting power. If your load is approaching manufacturer limits and clocks are dropping, reduce the load. Never use the temperature of a GPU of a different model as a guideline.
커넥터 변색·냄새가 있으면 즉시 사용을 중단하고 점검받으세요. 전원이 켜: If there is discoloration or odor in the connector, stop using it immediately and have it inspected. Do not press the connector while the power is on. Even if there are no external abnormalities, avoid repeated load tests and isolate driver and power issues using basic clock and normal cable conditions.
프레임 제한에 도달했다면 낮은 GPU 사용률은 정상일 수 있습니다. 목표: If you're hitting frame limits, low GPU utilization may be normal. If it's lower than your target, check your built-in GPU selection first. If you have the correct GPU but some CPU cores are saturated, suspect a CPU bottleneck. Don't blindly increase graphics options to increase GPU utilization.
한 게임만 종료되면 모드·오버레이를 제외하고 공식 파일 검사를 한 뒤 같: When only one game is finished, check the official files, excluding mods and overlays, and then compare the same scenes. If multiple games or your entire PC fails, expand the scope to Drivers, Base Clock, and Power. Back up your saved data before deleting it.
실제 재부팅이면 중지 코드·온도·전원 기록을 조사하고 부하를 줄여 비교하: If it is an actual reboot, examine the stop code, temperature, and power records and compare by reducing the load. If the PC works but the screen disappears, check the output/driver first. Do not force a reboot with repetitive load testing.
다른 앱은 정상이면 게임 파일·모드와 저장 위치의 읽기 지연을 점검하세요: If other apps are normal, check for delay in reading game files/modes and storage locations. If the entire PC freezes, check the memory, disk, and GPU. Force quitting a saved game may result in your progress being corrupted.
새 구역 첫 진입 때만 끊기고 다음 진입은 정상이면 셰이더·에셋 캐시 생: If it only hangs when you first enter a new area and the next entry is normal, check for shader/asset cache creation. If the disconnection continues even in the same scene, check background tasks and insufficient RAM/VRAM. Don't clear your cache every time.
시간이 지나며 온도가 오르고 클럭이 낮아지면 냉각·전력 제한을 점검하세요: If the temperature rises and the clock speed decreases over time, check the cooling and power limitations. If the temperature is stable but drops only in certain scenes, check the load/memory usage for that scene. Please do not compare FPS of different maps directly.
내장GPU나 절전 모드라면 지원되는 고성능 GPU·전원 프로필로 바꿔 같: If it is a built-in GPU or power saving mode, change to a supported high-performance GPU/power profile and compare the same scene. If the conditions are normal but it is slow, find the saturated CPU or GPU. Do not judge the failure based on Internet benchmark numbers under different conditions.
If the runtime is missing, install the official prerequisites for the game and run it again. If it ends without error, check the reliability record and quarantine history. Don't turn off security entirely or download DLLs from unknown sources.
활동이 있고 대규모 로딩 중이면 기다리세요. 매번 같은 구간에서 정지하면: If there is activity and a large loading, please wait. If it stops at the same section every time, check the mod/game files. If it continues to freeze without activity, obtain the log and exit. Don't force a reinstall after just one long load.
창 모드에서는 정상이면 전체화면 전환·HDR·주사율·오버레이를 한 항목씩: If it is normal in windowed mode, compare full screen switching, HDR, refresh rate, and overlay one by one. If all modes are the same, check the driver/game patch. Don't delete all of your save settings to fix screen transition issues.
DX12에서만 실패하면 게임·드라이버 지원 문제를 조사하고 공식 안정 모: If it only fails on DX12, investigate game/driver support issues and use the official stable mod. If other modes also fail, check for common GPU/power issues. Do not force unsupported run options or registry changes.
VRAM이 가득 차면 텍스처·해상도를 낮추고 GPU를 쓰는 다른 앱을 종: If VRAM is full, lower the texture/resolution and close other apps that use the GPU to compare. If this occurs even though you have enough VRAM, investigate game/driver errors. Increasing virtual memory does not increase VRAM.
재실행에서 줄어들면 셰이더 생성 가능성이 있으므로 게임의 사전 컴파일이: Wait until the game's pre-compilation is finished, as shader generation is likely to decrease on reruns. If the problem is the same every time, check cache storage permissions, free space, and game patches. Do not repeatedly delete cache that is being rebuilt.
게임만 끊기면 게임의 출력 선택·오디오 옵션을, 전체가 끊기면 장치 연결: If only the game disconnects, check the game's output selection/audio options. If the entire game disconnects, check the device connection/driver. If it only changes when you turn on the Bluetooth microphone, check Switching Call Profiles. Do not change multiple audio formats at once.
Windows에서는 정상이면 게임의 지원 입력 방식과 런처의 컨트롤러 설: On Windows, if normal, check the game's supported input methods and the launcher's controller settings. If it is not available in Windows, resolve connection/pairing first. Do not turn on duplicate virtual input tools at the same time.
중지 코드가 남으면 코드별 점검으로 진행하고 기본 클럭에서 최근 드라이버: If any stop codes remain, proceed with a code-by-code check and compare recent driver changes to base clocks. If there is a power cut, have the cable, power, and temperature checked. Do not repeat high load tests assuming that the game is the cause.
식힌 뒤에만 켜지면 냉각·보호 동작을 의심하고 통풍·팬을 점검하세요. 온: If it turns on only after cooling, suspect cooling/protection operation and check ventilation/fan. If the power is cut off regardless of temperature, the power supply needs to be checked. Do not bypass the power protection circuit.
직전 공식 안정 버전으로 되돌렸을 때 같은 장면이 정상이면 새 버전 회귀: If the same scene is normal when you revert to the previous official stable version, please report a possible regression to the new version. If reverting fails, check the game files/overlay. Don't keep reinstalling drivers without comparing versions.
전체화면에서만 발생하면 VRR·HDR·오버레이를 하나씩 바꾸고 원래 설정: If it only happens in full screen, change VRR, HDR, and overlay one by one and record the original settings. If the desktop/monitor menu also blinks, check the cable/panel first. Turning off multiple features at the same time makes it difficult to determine the cause.
유선에서 줄면 Wi-Fi 신호·혼잡을 점검하세요. 특정 서버만 높으면 지: If it decreases on the wired connection, check the Wi-Fi signal/congestion. If only a specific server is high, investigate the region and line path. If it is high for all connections, send records by time zone and server to your line company. Don't assume that changing your DNS alone will solve your game server lag.
공유기까지도 손실이면 무선·케이블·어댑터를 먼저 확인하세요. 게임에서만: If even the router is damaged, check the wireless, cable, and adapter first. If the loss is only in the game, check the server/line path. Do not determine actual packet loss based solely on a ping failure from one intermediate router.
최근 장치 변경 후 한 코드가 반복되면 해당 드라이버·장치를 우선 비교하: If a code repeats after a recent device change, compare the driver/device first. If the code is different every time or is accompanied by a memory error, check the basic clock, RAM, and disk. Don't just repeat regular recovery commands without code.
기본 설정에서도 검사 오류가 있으면 전원 분리 후 모듈·슬롯을 구분해 점: If there is a test error even in the default settings, disconnect the power and inspect each module/slot separately. If the check is ok, investigate the driver and repro in the dump. Don't completely rule out a RAM problem after just one diagnostic pass.
한 장치 사용 때만 반복되면 제조사 지원 드라이버로 롤백·업데이트를 하나: If it repeats only when using one device, compare rollbacks and updates one by one with the driver supported by the manufacturer. If the file name is different every time, check for memory instability. This does not mean that the Windows core files listed are always the cause.
특정 변경 이후라면 그 변경 하나를 되돌려 재발 여부를 확인하세요. 변경: If it's after a specific change, revert that one change to see if it happens again. If it occurs in multiple apps without change, check the memory and storage status. Don't start by turning off or increasing the page file.
If you are tuning, record the existing values and compare by restoring the manufacturer default settings. If the problem repeats even in the default state, have the CPU, RAM, PCIe, and power checked. Do not confirm a CPU defect based on the WHEA code alone.
특정 장치 작업과 연결되면 해당 제조사의 드라이버·펌웨어 안내를 확인하세: If connected to a specific device operation, check the manufacturer's driver/firmware instructions. If repeated across multiple devices, analyze the dump to narrow down the delay driver. Do not force replace the SATA controller with any other driver.
디스크 읽기 오류가 있으면 파일 확보를 우선하고 복구 명령 반복을 중단하: If there are disk read errors, prioritize freeing files and stop repeating the recovery command. If the disk is stable, check the latest security programs/updates and system files. Don't force kill essential Windows processes.
불필요한 장치를 분리하면 정상이면 하나씩 연결해 전원 전환을 막는 장치를: If it is normal to disconnect unnecessary devices, connect them one by one to find the device blocking the power switch. If the problem repeats on the built-in device, check the manufacturer's chipset/device driver. Do not turn off all power management features at the same time.
같은 파일명·작업에서 반복되면 해당 제품의 지원 드라이버와 공식 복구 절: If the same file name/task is repeated, apply the supported driver and official recovery procedure for the product first. If it repeats randomly without a specific file, check your system files and RAM. If you need to uninstall a security product, follow the support process to remain protected.
한 KB만 실패하면 해당 KB의 공식 알려진 문제와 전제 업데이트를 확인: If only one KB fails, check that KB's official known issues and premise updates. If all updates fail, check services, network, and components. Don't just delete the update cache.
활동이 있거나 펌웨어 업데이트 중이면 기다리고 전원을 유지하세요. 장시간: Please wait and maintain power when there is activity or firmware update. If the same point repeats without change for a long time, record the error/KB and follow the recovery procedure. Do not force quit repeatedly.
바탕화면에 들어가면 파일을 백업하고 해당 KB의 알려진 문제·드라이버 호: Once you are on the desktop, back up your files and check the KB for known issues and driver compatibility. If the revert itself repeats, consider removing recent updates from the recovery environment. Do not cut off the power during restoration.
작업 진행과 함께 부하가 줄면 유지관리 완료 후 같은 작업 속도를 다시: If the load decreases as work progresses, compare the same work speed again after maintenance is completed. If it's still slow after completion, investigate the top CPU/disk processes and driver changes. Distinguish between transient loads immediately after an update and persistent failures.
암호 로그인은 되면 PIN 문제로 분리하세요. 계정 암호도 실패하면 공식: If you can log in with a password, separate it as a PIN issue. If your account password also fails, use official account recovery. If your account is an organization, check with your administrator. Don't troubleshoot sign-in issues with authentication bypass tools or deleting user files.
