암호 로그인이 되면 Windows 설정에서 본인 확인 후 PIN 재설정을: Once you have logged in with your password, verify your identity in Windows Settings and then reset your PIN. If you don't know your password, recovering your official account and obtaining an encryption recovery key are priorities. Do not reset the TPM or randomly delete the PIN storage folder.
다른 계정이 정상이라면 원래 파일을 백업하고 새 프로필로 필요한 데이터만: If your other accounts are OK, review the procedures for backing up your original files and moving only the data you need to the new profile. If all accounts fail, also investigate disk/system corruption. Do not delete the original profile and user folders first.
특정 바로가기에서만 실패하면 해당 경로·네트워크 드라이브 문제를 확인하세: If it only fails on a specific shortcut, check for problems with the path or network drive. If all else fails, restart Explorer and check for recent shell extension changes. Do not change system ownership in bulk.
한 위치에서만 멈추면 그 드라이브의 응답·네트워크 연결·미리보기를 점검하: If it only stops at one location, check the drive's responsiveness, network connectivity, and preview. If it stops at all locations, check Explorer extensions and system files. For disks with read errors, data recovery takes priority over recovery.
탐색기 재시작으로 돌아오면 시작 앱·셸 확장 변경을 확인하고 재로그인으로: When you return by restarting Explorer, check the startup app/shell extension changes and compare recurrence by re-logging in. If it also freezes on other accounts, check your Windows components. Do not execute bulk app removal/re-registration commands from the Internet without verification.
If only file search fails, check the indexing status and whether search locations are included. If the search box does not respond, check the search process and Windows updates. Before rebuilding the index, check the scope of search omissions.
If other internet connections are normal, first review Store recovery in the app settings. If the problem persists after recovery, follow the official cache reset/support procedure. Before resetting, check your account and app data and do not force delete system apps.
한 앱이면 공식 복구 설치·필수 런타임을 확인하고 사용자 데이터는 백업하: If it's just one app, install the official recovery, check the required runtime, and back up user data. If multiple apps fail at the same time, check permissions, system files, and memory. Don't make running Administrator the default for all apps.
다른 설치가 진행 중이면 완료를 기다리세요. 특정 앱만 실패하면 제작사: If another installation is in progress, wait for it to complete. If only a specific app fails, check the manufacturer's recovery/uninstall tool. If all installations fail, check Installer permissions. Do not manually delete Program Files or the installation registry.
Visual C++·DirectX 같은 런타임 파일이면 공식 설치 패키지: If it is a runtime file such as Visual C++/DirectX, restore it with the official installation package. If it is an app-specific DLL, use the official app recovery install. Do not put files from DLL download sites in your system folder.
디스크가 안정적이면 공식 DISM 복구 후 SFC 결과를 비교하세요. 읽: If your disk is stable, compare SFC results after official DISM recovery. If read errors or the same damage repeat, check the storage device and RAM after backing up. Do not clear logs to hide recovery failures.
켜져 있을 때만 틀리면 시간대·자동 동기화·조직 정책을 확인하세요. 전원: If it is incorrect only when it is turned on, check your time zone, automatic sync, and organization policies. After disconnecting the power source, once the BIOS has reset to time, consider checking the RTC battery. Don't avoid certificate warnings by arbitrarily changing the date.
하드웨어 변경 뒤라면 계정 연결·정품 인증 문제 해결사를 통해 본인 라이: If you have changed hardware, check your license using the account linking/activation troubleshooter. If there is a discrepancy in edition or organization key, please contact your sales representative or administrator. Do not use authentication bypass programs.
한 계정에서만 실패하면 프로필·시작 앱을 점검하고 기존 파일은 보존하세요: If it fails on only one account, check the profile/startup app and preserve existing files. If all accounts fail, check Windows Update and system files. Do not delete the Settings app files directly.
디스크가 정상이라면 공식 복구 환경·설치 미디어를 통한 복구를 검토하세요: If the disk is normal, consider recovering using an official recovery environment/installation media. If there is a disk error, do not repeat the reset. The file retention option is not a substitute for separate backups.
다른 정상 복원 지점이 있으면 백업 후 복구 환경에서 지원되는 복원을 검: If you have another healthy restore point, review the supported restores in the Post-Backup Recovery experience. If multiple points fail with the same disk error, checking the drive is a priority. Do not delete all restore points to resolve a restore failure.
설치가 진행 중이면 전원을 유지하고 완료·재부팅 후 부하가 내려가는지 보: While the installation is in progress, keep the power on and see if the load goes down after completion and reboot. If the same KB failure repeats, proceed with code-specific recovery. Don't hide the load by permanently stopping the update service.
한 앱이 점유하면 작업 저장 후 그 앱을 종료·복구하고 동일 작업의 반응: If one app takes over, save your work, then close/restore that app and compare the response to the same work. If the utilization is low but everything is slow, check the temperature, clock, and disk response. Do not install multiple optimization programs before checking the cause.
시작 앱을 하나씩 비활성화하고 다음 로그인에서 차이를 비교하세요. 보안·: Disable startup apps one by one and compare the difference on your next login. Do not disable security/driver items carelessly. If the disk is saturated even if you reduce the number of startup apps, check the storage and update load. Investigate pre-boot delays separately.
본인이 실행한 작업이면 완료 후 내려가는지 보세요. 알 수 없는 파일은: If you executed the task, see if it goes down after completion. For unknown files, check the path and signature and perform a security check. If system interrupts are high, disconnect the most recently connected device and compare. Don't kill system processes whose names you don't know.
앱을 닫은 뒤 사용 가능 메모리가 회복되면 동시 실행량을 줄이고 필요한: After closing apps and freeing up memory, reduce the amount of concurrent execution and review how much RAM you need. If only one process continues to grow, isolate it as a memory leak. Don't use memory cleaning tools just because you have a lot of cache.
앱 종료 후 회복되면 앱·확장 기능 버전을 비교하고 증가 패턴을 제작사에: Once the app has recovered after exiting, compare the app/extension versions and report the increase pattern to the manufacturer. If the non-paged pool continues to increase even after the app is closed, investigate driver leaks. Turning off the page file does not fix the leak.
업데이트·복사 작업이 진행 중이면 완료 뒤 정상화되는지 확인하세요. 전송: If an update/copy operation is in progress, check whether it returns to normal after completion. If the transfer volume is low and the response time is high or there are errors, check the drive after backing up. Don't decide to format your disk based solely on the 100% mark.
임시 파일은 삭제 목록에서 다운로드 폴더 등 개인 파일 포함 여부를 검토: For temporary files, check whether they include personal files such as download folders in the deletion list and then organize them. If your system folder is large, use the supported organizing feature. Do not delete the WinSxS·Installer folder directly.
If it increases only when running a specific app, check the app's cache limit and error recurrence first. If system dumps persist, investigate the cause of the crash. Don't just repeatedly delete files or clear the update cache in progress.
최근 장착했다면 전원 분리 후 슬롯 호환성·공유 레인·장착 상태를 설명서: If it was recently installed, disconnect the power source and compare slot compatibility, shared lanes, and installation status with the manual. If your existing normal SSD has disappeared, prioritize securing data and have it inspected. BIOS recognition issues cannot be resolved with the Windows reset command.
기존 볼륨은 보이고 문자만 없으면 드라이브 문자 문제로 분리하세요. 기존: If the existing volume is visible and only has a letter, isolate it due to a drive letter problem. If your existing data disk looks like it needs to be initialized, stop. Do not initialize or create a new volume before confirming that the disk is new and empty.
이상음 없이 연결 후 달라지면 전원 분리 상태에서 정상 SATA 데이터·: If there is a difference after connecting without any abnormal noise, disconnect the power and compare with a normal SATA data/power cable. Click · 0 GB · Repeat If the recognition is not resolved, turn off the power and consult about recovery. If you have important data, do not connect repeatedly.
정상 용량·기존 파티션이 보이면 문자·마운트 문제를 점검하세요. 0GB·: If normal capacity/existing partition is visible, check for text/mount issues. If 0GB/RAW/requires initialization or connection is lost, do not format but consider cable/power/data recovery.
직결·다른 정상 케이블에서 안정적이면 허브·케이블을 교체하고 파일 손상을: If it is stable with a direct connection or other normal cable, replace the hub/cable and check for file damage. If the disconnection continues, secure important files first. Do not repeat file system repairs or speed tests on disks with unstable connections.
일반 데이터 볼륨만 문자가 없다면 사용하지 않는 문자를 할당하고 파일이: If only the generic data volume does not have a letter, assign an unused letter and see if the file is visible. If it is a RAW/unallocated/recovery partition, do not randomly assign letters. Check your existing file structure first.
새 빈 디스크가 맞을 때만 모델·용량을 확인하고 새 볼륨 생성을 진행하세: Only create a new volume after confirming that the disk is new and empty and that its model and capacity match the intended target. If it previously held files, stop writing to it: its partition table may be damaged. Creating or formatting a volume can reduce the chance of recovery.
물리 잠금이면 해제 후 불필요한 새 테스트 파일로만 저장 여부를 확인하세: If it is a physical lock, check whether it is saved only as a new test file after unlocking. If it becomes read-only again without a lock, it may be in a fault-protected state. Copy data and avoid repeated forced de-attribution/formatting.
작은 파일에서만 느리면 파일 수·백신 검사 영향을 구분하세요. 큰 파일: If it is only slow on small files, distinguish between the impact of the number of files and the anti-virus scan. If only the second half of a large file is slow, check for cache exhaustion. If there is a pause, error, or loss of recognition, data backup takes precedence over speed adjustment. Don't confuse copying within the same disk with copying between devices.
불량 섹터·미디어 오류가 증가하면 쓰기·부하를 줄이고 중요한 파일부터 백: If bad sectors and media errors increase, reduce writing and load and back up important files first. If there is only a connection error, check the cable and port together. Do not reset SMART alerts to clear them or consider the repair complete.
새로운 반복 클릭과 읽기 실패면 전원을 끄고 중요 데이터 복구를 상담하세: If new repeated clicking accompanies read failures, turn the drive off and consult a data recovery service about important files. Sound alone cannot rule out physical damage. Do not freeze, strike or open the drive, or repeatedly run CHKDSK.
원본은 정상이면 다른 정상 저장장치로 다시 복사하고 지원된다면 체크섬을: If the original is normal, copy it again to another normal storage device and compare the checksums if supported. If multiple files continue to get corrupted, check your disk/RAM. Do not overwrite the recovery results over the corrupted files.
파일시스템 오류가 반복되면 먼저 백업하고 디스크 상태·케이블·종료 실패를: If the file system error repeats, back up first and check disk status, cable, and shutdown failure. If there is a physics error, do not repeat the repair. Forcing the startup check to be hidden does not resolve the cause.
식힌 뒤 돌아오면 냉각·방열판 접촉을 점검하되 정상 온도에서도 펌웨어·전: Once it cools down and returns, check the cooling/heatsink contacts, but do not rule out firmware/power issues even at normal temperatures. If you turn off repeated recognition, secure the data first and reduce its use. Do not start firmware update/load test in an unstable state.
후반만 느리면 캐시 특성을, 온도 상승과 함께 느리면 스로틀링을 확인하세: If only the second half is slow, check the cache characteristics, and if it is slow along with temperature rise, check the throttling. If it is slow from the beginning, check slot/link and background I/O. If there are any signs of failure, stop the benchmark and back up.
특정 드라이브 접근 때만 멈추면 그 드라이브의 파일을 우선 확보하고 연결: If it stops only when accessing a specific drive, secure the files on that drive first and check the connection/status. If the error is the same on other drives without errors, check the driver/memory. Do not repeat the recovery command on the read error disk first.
한 모듈만 빠졌다면 전원 분리 후 모듈·슬롯을 한 번에 하나씩 바꿔 문제: If only one module is missing, disconnect the power and replace the module/slot one at a time to isolate the problem. If you cannot see all modules, check compatibility/CPU memory channel. Do not touch RAM when the power is on.
BIOS부터 절반이면 모듈·슬롯·채널을 점검하고 Windows만 적으면: If it's only half of the BIOS, check the modules, slots, and channels, and if it's only Windows, check the OS restrictions and reservations. Don't limit your system configuration's maximum memory to an arbitrary number. Record the original settings and check with the manufacturer's support procedures.
기본 설정은 안정적이면 프로필·보드·메모리 컨트롤러 조합의 한계를 확인하: If the default settings are stable, check the limitations of the profile/board/memory controller combination. If there is an error even in the basic state, module/slot inspection is required. Do not recklessly increase the voltage for stabilization.
한 모듈에서 반복되면 해당 모듈 점검·보증을 검토하고 중요한 파일을 백업: If repetition occurs in one module, review the module inspection/warranty and back up important files. Follow the slot to check the board and CPU channels. Don't conclude that your RAM is bad just because an app crashes.
유휴부터 높거나 팬·펌프가 멈췄다면 부하를 중단하고 냉각 장치 연결·장착: If the idle is high or the fan/pump has stopped, stop the load and check the connection/installation of the cooling device. If it is high only at load, check power/ventilation and throttling together. Do not decide to reapply thermal paste based on temperature alone.
앱 작업이면 완료 후 내려가는지 확인하고, 인터럽트면 최근 주변기기를 분: If it's an app task, check if it goes down after completion, and if it's interrupted, disconnect the recent peripheral device and compare it. If the number of unknown processes is high even when idle, check the path/signature and security checks. Don't blindly turn off system services just to lower CPU usage.
작업 중 온도 한계면 냉각을, 어댑터·전력 제한이면 제조사 전원 프로필을: If workload temperatures reach the limit, check cooling. If the adapter or power limit is the constraint, check the manufacturer power profile. If the clock remains stuck despite normal temperature and power, have the firmware and sensors checked. Do not disable protections such as PROCHOT.
기존 CPU가 동작하면 지원 BIOS로 업데이트할 수 있는지 제조사 절차: If your existing CPU works, check the manufacturer's procedures to see if you can update to a supported BIOS. If POST does not work even though support is provided, disconnect the power source and have the auxiliary power source and installation checked. Do not apply arbitrary BIOS files without a screen.
원래 구성은 정상이면 새 모듈의 규격·혼용·권장 슬롯을 하나씩 비교하세요: If the original configuration is normal, compare the specifications, mixing, and recommended slots of the new module one by one. If the original configuration fails, disconnect the power and recheck the mounting condition. Do not turn off the power repeatedly during training.
모든 기기가 실패하면 모뎀·공유기·회선 장애를 먼저 확인하세요. PC만: If all devices fail, first check for modem, router, or line failure. If only the PC fails, narrow the scope in that order: adapter, IP, gateway, and DNS. Do not factory reset the router first.
다른 기기도 실패하면 회선·공유기 또는 인증 문제를 확인하세요. 해당 P: If other devices also fail, check for line/router or authentication issues. If only the PC fails, investigate the IP, gateway, and VPN. A successful Wi-Fi connection does not mean that the Internet line is normal.
어댑터가 있으면 비행기 모드·비활성화·WLAN 서비스를 확인하세요. 장치: If you have an adapter, check airplane mode/disable/WLAN service. If the device itself is not present, check the laptop manufacturer's wireless/chipset drivers and hardware status. Do not assume that Wi-Fi is normal just because of Bluetooth recognition.
한 네트워크만 실패하면 비밀번호를 확보한 뒤 저장 프로필 재연결을 검토하: If only one network fails, obtain the password and consider reconnecting the saved profile. If all Wi-Fi fails, check your wireless drivers. Check with your administrator about the certificate and security settings for your organization's wireless network.
PC만 끊기면 무선 드라이버·전원 관리를 하나씩 비교하세요. 여러 기기가: If only your PC is disconnected, compare wireless drivers and power management one by one. If multiple devices disconnect at the same time, check the router, interference, and line. Do not factory reset the network before checking the cause.
가까이서 빨라지면 거리·벽·안테나·간섭을 점검하세요. 유선도 느리면 회선: If you get closer and faster, check for distance, walls, antennas, and interference. If the wired connection is also slow, expand the scope to line/server issues. Wi-Fi connection speed and actual Internet speed are different.
링크가 생기면 IP 자동 할당과 게이트웨이를 확인하세요. 여전히 케이블: Once you have the link, check the IP auto assignment and gateway. If the cable is still not connected, check the NIC/port/driver. Do not confuse DHCP issues with physical cable issues.
169.254 주소이거나 게이트웨이가 없으면 케이블 링크와 공유기 DHC: If the address is 169.254 or there is no gateway, check the cable link and router DHCP. If your network uses a static IP, check with the administrator for the correct value. Do not copy the IP of another PC.
1Gbps 지원 포트와 정상 4페어 케이블로 바꾸면 케이블·포트 제한을: You can distinguish cable/port limitations by changing to a 1Gbps-supporting port and a normal 4-pair cable. If you're still getting 100Mbps, check for both device support and auto-negotiation. Don't force a speed that isn't supported.
한 PC만 실패하면 로컬 DNS 캐시와 지정 서버를 확인하세요. 여러 기: If only one PC fails, check your local DNS cache and designated servers. If multiple devices are only failing the same domain, also look into site-side DNS. Do not replace your in-house DNS with public DNS.
현재 브라우저에서만 실패하면 쿠키·확장 기능을, 현재 회선에서만 실패하면: If the failure occurs only in the current browser, check the cookies/extensions, and if the failure occurs only on the current line, check the DNS/filter. If other lines also fail to the same site, contact the site administrator. Do not connect by ignoring the certificate warning.
알 수 없는 장치가 있으면 모델별 공식 드라이버를 다른 장치로 받아 설치: If there is an unknown device, download and install the official driver for that model for another device. If you don't have any device at all, check BIOS settings, chipset, and hardware. Obtain the reinstallation file before deleting the existing driver.
드라이버 변경 직후라면 공식 이전 버전 또는 장치 관리자 롤백으로 비교하: If you just changed the driver, compare with an official previous version or Device Manager Rollback. If the drivers are the same, check the VPN/IP settings. Record your static IP and VPN reset information before resetting the network.
VPN 중에만 실패하면 서버·조직 정책·허용된 DNS를 확인하세요. 종료: If it only fails during VPN, check the server/organization policy/allowed DNS. If it still fails after termination, follow the VPN app's official recovery/virtual adapter procedures. Don't circumvent your organization's security policies.
개인 PC에서 잘못 넣은 프록시만 원래 값으로 복원하고 접속을 비교하세요: On your personal PC, restore only the proxy you entered incorrectly to its original value and compare connections. If it is an organization setting or it returns even after deleting it, check the cause through an administrator/security check. Do not tamper with the management proxy.
웹은 정상이라면 상태 감지 경로·VPN 정책을 조사하세요. 실제도 실패하: If the web is normal, check the health detection path and VPN policy. If it actually fails, check the IP/gateway. If other devices are also restricted, check the router and line. Don't reset your entire network based on just one status icon.
공유기부터 높으면 Wi-Fi·케이블을, 공유기는 낮고 외부만 높으면 회선: If the router is high, check the Wi-Fi/cable. If the router is low and only the outside is high, check the line/congestion. If only a specific destination is high, research the server region/route. ICMP response delay and app delay are not always the same.
유선에서는 없으면 무선 신호·간섭을 먼저 점검하세요. 양쪽 모두 손실이면: If you don't have a wired connection, check for wireless signals/interference first. If there is a loss on both sides, check the cable, router, and line. Do not assume that a line failure is the result of only an intermediate hop not responding.
IP 경로는 되고 이름만 실패하면 이름 해석을, 인증만 실패하면 계정·공: If access by IP works but the server name fails, check name resolution. If authentication fails, check the account and share permissions. If both paths fail, an administrator should check server connectivity, SMB and firewall rules. Do not enable SMB1 or guest access indiscriminately.
개인망에서 잘못 지정한 고정 IP라면 원래 자동 할당으로 복원하고 새 주: If it is a static IP assigned incorrectly on a private network, restore the original automatic assignment and check the new address. Devices that require static IPs require administrators to sort out address conflicts and DHCP scopes. Don't guess and enter random empty addresses.
새 프로필은 빠르면 기존 확장·캐시·프록시를 하나씩 점검하세요. 모든 브: For new profiles, check existing extensions, caches, and proxies one by one as soon as possible. If all browsers are slow, investigate your DNS, security checks, and site responses. Once your speed measurement is normal, don't rule out any network issues.
장치가 보이면 오류 코드와 비활성화·드라이버 상태를 확인하세요. 아예 없: If you see the device, check the error code and disable/driver status. If there are none, check the manufacturer's wireless driver and power recovery procedures. Hardware recognition cannot be restored by deleting all pairing information.
검색은 되는데 연결만 실패하면 기존 연결을 해제하고 해당 장치의 페어링: If it searches but fails to connect, disconnect the existing connection and reset the pairing record for the device. If the search doesn't work, check the range, battery, and support profiles. Obtain manufacturer reconnection procedures before resetting the device.
가까이서 안정되면 간섭·안테나를, 절전 뒤에만 실패하면 드라이버·전원 관: If it stabilizes nearby, check the interference/antenna, and if it fails only after power saving, check the driver/power management. If only one peripheral is disconnected, compare it to other hosts. Don't delete all your Bluetooth device history at once.
Windows 테스트 소리는 나면 앱의 출력 설정을 수정하고 앱을 다시: If you hear the Windows test sound, modify the app's output settings and run the app again. If there is no test sound, check the earphone's connection to other devices and the audio profile. The connected indication does not guarantee successful audio output.
마이크 사용 때만 변하면 통화 프로필·기기 대역폭 한계를 확인하고 별도: If it changes only when using the microphone, check the call profile and device bandwidth limits and consider using a separate microphone. If music playback alone is bad, check the distance, interference, and output format. Not all Bluetooth devices support high-quality two-way audio.
If things get better up close, adjust the dongle/antenna positions and reconnect one by one. If it is the same up close, check the power saving/driver and operation on another PC. Distinguish between system-wide freezes and mouse-specific lag.
다른 정상 포트에서 되면 기존 포트·허브를 점검하세요. 모든 PC에서 실: If it happens on another normal port, check the existing port/hub. If it fails on all PCs, check cables/devices. If it is a storage device, do not accept the initialization/format instructions right away.
직결·정상 케이블에서 안정되면 허브 전력·접촉 문제를 확인하세요. 다른: If it is stable with a direct/normal cable, check for hub power/contact problems. If the same problem occurs on other PCs, check the device itself. Stop file repair or speed test while the storage device is disconnected.
전면만 실패하면 전원 분리 후 전면 패널 케이블·헤더를 점검하세요. 손상: If only the front fails, disconnect the power and check the front panel cable/header. If there are any signs of damage, foreign matter, or overheating, stop using that port. Do not clean powered ports with metal tools.
직결에서 빨라지면 허브·케이블의 지원 규격을 확인하세요. 큰 파일 후반만: If direct connection is faster, check the supported specifications of the hub and cable. If only the second half of a large file is slow, check the storage cache. Just because it's a blue port doesn't guarantee maximum speed.
주변기기 하나만 문제면 다른 정상 케이블·PC에서 같은 장치를 비교하세요: If the problem is with only one peripheral device, compare the same device with another normal cable/PC. If multiple devices fail on one controller, check the chipset/port power. Do not delete all USB drivers with Code 43 alone.
단독은 정상이면 허브의 전원 어댑터·총 전력·대역폭을 확인하세요. 한 장: If standalone is normal, check the hub's power adapter, total power, and bandwidth. If only one device fails in either the hub or direct connection, check that device. Do not connect an adapter that does not match the hub's ratings.
BIOS에서는 되면 Windows의 필터 키·입력 드라이버·앱을 확인하세: If it works in BIOS, check the Windows filter keys, input drivers, and apps. If it doesn't work on another PC, check the cables, battery, and keyboard. Do not remove your input device before you have a way to log in.
특정 앱만 실패하면 단축키·키 매핑·입력 언어를 확인하세요. 같은 물리: If only a specific app fails, check the shortcuts, key mapping, and input language. If the same physical key fails in all apps, check for contamination/switches. If liquid enters the product, turn off the power and discontinue use.
짧은 입력도 중복되고 다른 PC도 같으면 스위치 채터링·펌웨어를 점검하세: If short inputs are duplicated and the same occurs on other PCs, check the switch chattering/firmware. If it is inconvenient to only press and hold, adjust the repeat delay. Don’t assume that the problem has been repaired after hiding the symptoms of the problem through filter settings.
If it clicks, check the sensor/surface, if there is no input at all, check the battery/connection. If it also fails on another PC, check your mouse. Distinguish between a complete Windows freeze and an input device failure.
무선에서만 나쁘면 수신기 거리·간섭·배터리를 비교하세요. 유선도 같으면: If it's only bad for wireless, compare receiver distance, interference, and battery. If the wires are the same, check the system load and display response. Compare the same operation before and after changing the polling rate.
다른 PC에서도 같으면 스위치 마모 가능성이 있으므로 수리·교체를 검토하: If the same problem occurs on other PCs, the switch may be worn, so consider repairing or replacing it. If it's the same in one app, check the app settings. Changing the double-click speed will not fix a broken switch.
If you turn it back on in Settings, see if it persists even after rebooting and disconnecting the external mouse. If the device is not present, check the manufacturer's touchpad/serial I/O driver. Do not uninstall existing drivers without a replacement input device.
입력 중에만 생기면 민감도·팜 리젝션을 조절하고 표면을 마른 상태로 유지: If it only occurs while typing, adjust sensitivity/palm rejection and keep the surface dry. If the device moves or the touchpad lifts when you release it, stop using it and have the battery checked for swelling or hardware.
USB·Bluetooth 연결만 보이고 입력 장치가 없으면 모델의 공식: If you only see USB/Bluetooth connection and no input device, check the official driver/input mode for your model. If the Windows test is normal, proceed with the input settings for each game. Do not add multiple virtual controllers at the same time.
다른 리더기에서 보이면 기존 리더기·어댑터 접촉을 점검하세요. RAW·0: If it is visible on another reader, check the existing reader/adapter contacts. If it is RAW, 0GB, or unallocated, stop writing and consider recovery. Do not overwrite formatting or recovery results on the original card.
If the problem is with the tab/reader, change to a normal adapter and copy important files first. If it continues to be write-protected even without a lock, the card may be in failure protection. Prioritize securing and replacing data over forced formatting.
직결에서는 인식되면 허브·연장 케이블·USB 전력을 점검하세요. 다른 P: In direct connection, if it is recognized, check the hub, extension cable, and USB power. If other PCs cannot find the device, you need to check the cables and webcam. Unrecognized devices cannot be recovered by setting permissions alone.
테스트 소리는 나면 앱별 출력·음소거를 점검하세요. 테스트도 안 나면 스: If you hear a test sound, check the output/mute for each app. If the test does not work, check the speaker power source, cable, output device, and driver. Also note that the monitor does not have speakers.
If there is an error device, check the audio/chipset driver for your PC model. If you don't have HDMI audio, check your GPU driver/output connections. Do not remove all audio devices at once.
한 출력에서만 깨지면 단자·케이블·해당 장치 향상 기능을 확인하세요. 모: If it breaks only on one output, check the terminal, cable, and corresponding device enhancements. If all outputs crash together under system load, investigate driver latency. Compare sampling formats one at a time within the supported range.
특정 앱만 작으면 앱 볼륨 믹서·앱 출력을 조정하세요. 모든 앱이 작으면: If only a specific app is small, adjust the app volume mixer and app output. If all apps are small, check the output device/terminal/device rating. Be careful of damage to your hearing and speakers before increasing the amplification significantly.
If only the output selection has changed, restore to the original device and check the test sound. If there is no output, consider rolling back or reinstalling the manufacturer's driver. Rather than removing all updates, narrow down what has changed.
If the headphones are OK, check the jack detection/device type of the manufacturer's audio console. If the terminal breaks due to movement, a contact check is required. Compare the front and rear terminals under the same conditions.
Windows에서는 반응하면 앱의 마이크 선택·개인정보 권한을 확인하세요: On Windows, if it responds, check the app's microphone selection and privacy permissions. If the level does not move, check the connection/input mute/driver. Allowing app permissions alone cannot solve physical connection issues.
Windows부터 작으면 장치 입력 레벨·지원되는 증폭·연결 규격을 점검: Starting with Windows, check the device input level, supported amplification, and connection specifications. If Windows is normal and the app is small, compare the app's automatic sensitivity and noise suppression. Excessive amplification can create noise and clipping.
Shorten the path for speaker sound to re-enter the microphone once it is removed from the headphones. If it persists, check monitoring/virtual audio routing for each app. Do not turn on multiple monitoring paths at the same time.
If the app is muted or has a different output, correct only those items and then restart the app. If the mixer is also normal, check for output/file problems within the app itself. Don't start by uninstalling the entire system audio driver.
카메라 앱은 정상이면 문제 앱의 권한·장치 선택·브라우저 권한을 확인하세: If the camera app is normal, check the permissions, device selection, and browser permissions of the problematic app. If all apps fail, check device recognition/manufacturer drivers. Grant permission only to apps that require the camera.
한 사이트만 막히면 그 사이트의 권한과 선택 장치만 수정하세요. 조직에서: If only one site is blocked, only modify that site's permissions and options. If it says managed by your organization, ask your administrator. Do not change the registry to bypass policies or security products.
카메라 앱은 정상이면 화상 앱의 선택 장치·가상 카메라·배경 효과를 점검: If the camera app is normal, check the selected device, virtual camera, and background effects in the video app. If all apps are black, check your device/driver/exposure. First distinguish between lens obstruction and hardware failure.
단독 실행이 되면 앱을 하나씩 켜 점유 경로를 확인하세요. 재부팅 뒤 단: When it runs independently, open the apps one by one to check the occupied paths. If standalone execution fails after rebooting, check permissions, drivers, and security policies. Do not stop camera services or security all at once.
IP로 접근되는데 검색만 안 되면 제조사 방식의 수동 추가·검색 서비스를: If you are accessed by IP but cannot search, check the manufacturer's manual addition and search service. If IP access fails, check the same network, power, and connection first. Do not install the driver repeatedly just because the printer fails to be discovered.
프린터는 정상이고 IP만 바뀌었다면 올바른 포트·주소로 수정하세요. 자체: If the printer is normal and only the IP has changed, change it to the correct port/address. If self-printing also fails, resolve the device error first. Don't hide the problem by making another printer the default.
문제 작업만 취소하고 대기열이 비면 작은 테스트 문서를 인쇄하세요. 취소: Just cancel the problem job and print a small test document when the queue is empty. If cancellation does not work, follow the administrator/manufacturer's spooler recovery procedures. Clearing a queue can also clear other users' jobs.
특정 프린터 드라이버 설치 후 반복되면 해당 드라이버의 지원 버전·제거: If the problem repeats after installing a specific printer driver, check the supported version and uninstallation procedures for that driver. If the service fails immediately after starting, narrow down the cause by looking at the logs. Do not change system folder permissions or delete spool files first.
If only large files are slow, compare the resolution, duplex, and app output method one by one. If all documents are slow, check the network, driver, and printer specifications. Also consider the physical print speed limitations of your device.
자체 출력도 나쁘면 잉크·토너·노즐·정렬을 제조사 절차로 점검하세요. 자: If the self-printing is bad, check the ink, toner, nozzle, and alignment according to the manufacturer's procedures. If self-printing is normal, check the app, paper type, and quality settings. Repeated head cleaning may result in excessive ink consumption.
If other apps also fail, check the manufacturer-supported drivers and existing cue settings. If only one app is failing, isolate the printing issue to each app. Do not install using driver tools from unknown sources or unsigned.
같은 망인데 IP 접근은 되면 자동 검색보다 제조사의 주소 기반 추가를: If it is the same network and IP access is possible, consider adding based on the manufacturer's address rather than automatic search. If it is a different network or is isolated, check the connection policy with the administrator. Do not turn off the router security entirely.
인쇄만 되면 스캔 전용 드라이버·WIA·TWAIN 지원을 확인하세요. 장: If you just want to print, check out the scan-only driver, WIA, and TWAIN support. If you do not have the device itself, check the USB/network connection first. Just installing the printer driver does not prepare the scanning function.
한 파일만 실패하면 다른 이름으로 복사해 파일·폰트·개체 문제를 점검하세: If only one file fails, copy it under a different name and check for file, font, or object problems. If only the entire app fails, check the app update/print settings. Expand your scope to system queues and drivers only when all apps fail.
다른 정상 호환 충전기로 인식되면 기존 어댑터·케이블을 점검하세요. 어떤: If it is recognized as another normal compatible charger, check the existing adapter/cable. If any charger is not recognized, have the port and power circuit checked. If the battery swells or overheats, stop charging.
한도 근처에서 멈추면 정상 제한일 수 있습니다. 제조사 설명의 재충전 시: If it stops near the limit, it may be a normal limit. Check the manufacturer's instructions for the conditions for starting recharge. If charging does not occur even though the remaining charge is low, check the adapter output and battery condition. Do not start by deleting the driver.
유휴에서는 충전되면 독·USB-C 전력 협상·고부하 시 제조사 보조 배터: When charging at idle, check the operation of the manufacturer's auxiliary battery during dock/USB-C power negotiation and high load. If it decreases even when idle, have the charger and battery inspected. Do not continue to use chargers with insufficient output or connect arbitrary high-voltage adapters.
완충 용량이 크게 줄었으면 배터리 열화를, 특정 앱이 크면 백그라운드·G: If the charging capacity has decreased significantly, check for battery deterioration, and if a specific app is large, check for background/GPU usage. If the capacity is normal but suddenly turns off, it is necessary to measure the remaining capacity and check the battery. Do not completely discharge the battery repeatedly.
설정한 충전 한도에서만 멈추면 정상 동작일 수 있습니다. 한도를 확인하세: If it stops only at the set charging limit, it may be operating normally. Check your limits. If the value does not change even when the remaining power is low or it suddenly turns off, check the EC/battery. Do not repeat forced full discharge even for calibration purposes.
BIOS는 인식하고 Windows만 없으면 제조사 칩셋·전원 드라이버와: If the BIOS is recognized but Windows is not available, check the manufacturer's chipset/power driver and support recovery procedures. If you can't find the BIOS, have the battery/connection checked. Do not disconnect the built-in battery while it is connected to power.
안전하게 할 수 있으면 전원을 끄고 충전기를 분리한 뒤 가연물에서 떨어뜨: If safe, shut it down, disconnect the charger and keep it away from flammable materials. Contact the manufacturer for repair. If there is smoke, excessive heat or fire, do not approach or move it; seek emergency assistance. Do not puncture, charge, crush or put the battery in household waste.
유휴부터 높으면 막힌 흡배기·팬을, 특정 작업에서만 높으면 해당 부품의: If it is high from idle, check for a clogged intake/exhaust fan or a clogged intake/exhaust fan, and if it is high only during certain operations, check the cooling/power of the relevant parts. End of protection: Stop use if there is an odor. Don't apply one normal temperature standard to all components.
환경을 바꾸면 개선되면 흡배기 확보와 전원 프로필을 조정하세요. 팬 미동: If the environment improves, adjust the intake and exhaust and power profile. If the fan does not operate or protection ends, have it inspected by the manufacturer. Do not refrigerate or freeze a hot laptop or clean the interior while it is turned on.
고부하와 함께 커지면 부하 종료 후 줄어드는지 확인하고 냉각 경로를 점검: If it increases with high load, check to see if it decreases after the load ends and check the cooling path. If scratches or vibration remain, disconnect the power source and inspect the cable contact and bearings. Do not stop the rotating fan with your hand.
백그라운드 작업이 높으면 작업 완료 후 팬 속도가 내려가는지 보세요. 낮: If background activity is high, see if the fan speed goes down after the task is completed. If overheating or high rotation occurs even at low load, check the sensor and cooler. Do not turn off the fan to reduce noise.
정상 정지 조건이면 오류가 아닐 수 있습니다. 부하 시 안전 범위에서 회: If it is a normal stopping condition, it may not be an error. See if it starts spinning in the safe range under load. If it stops spinning when it should, stop the load, disconnect the power, and check the fan connection/device. Do not continue testing while increasing the temperature.
열과 연결되면 고부하를 중단하고 통풍구·팬·방열판 점검을 받으세요. 온도: If it is connected to heat, stop heavy loads and inspect the vent, fan, and heat sink. If it turns off regardless of temperature, also investigate adapter/power issues. Do not bypass thermal protection or force a repeat boot.
배터리에서만 클럭·GPU 전력이 낮으면 정상 전력 제한인지 제조사 사양을: If clock/GPU power is low only on battery, check the manufacturer's specifications to see if it is a normal power limit. If it is unusually slow or suddenly turns off, check the battery status and firmware. Do not force AC performance by disabling protection restrictions.
화면만 없으면 영상 출력·그래픽 드라이버를, PC 전체면 칩셋·전원 전환: If there is only a screen, check the video output/graphics driver, and check the chipset/power switch for the entire PC. Once the external devices are normalized by disconnecting them, reconnect them one by one. Consider losing any unsaved work before force quitting.
If it is Do nothing, change it to your desired power saving behavior and check for actual entry. If you cannot enter even though the settings are correct, check the running app, lid sensor, and manufacturer utility. Do not put devices that are not power saving in your bag.
특정 장치·작업이 확인되면 그 항목의 깨우기 권한만 검토하세요. 원인이: Once a specific device/task is identified, only review the wake permissions for that item. If there is no cause, investigate the wake-up time of the event. Do not turn off all reservation and network power functions at once.
지원되지만 비활성화면 관리자 권한과 조직 정책을 확인한 뒤 공식 활성화: If it's supported but disabled, check your administrator permissions and organization policies and follow the official activation process. If it is not supported due to hardware or policy, use a supported shutdown/sleep method. Just adding a menu does not mean that a feature is supported.
